npc.lily.stdmod_8: Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_9: No, you haven't. If you're looking for the way to Hyacinth, just leave the village to the north and then go east. I've marked it on your map!
npc.lily.voice_1: Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.voice_2: Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.voice_3: Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.voice_4: Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.voice_5: Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.voice_6: I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lisander.greet_msg_1: I'd rather be left in {peace}. Keep it short.
npc.lisander.say_1: A cookie? Sure, is it for free?
npc.lisander.say_2: Whatever you have there, I think I don't want it.
npc.lisander.say_3: Errrkss - coughcough - what the - heck did you put in there? Get out of my sight!
npc.lizard_tunnel_guard.spotted: The guards have spotted you. You were forcibly dragged into a small cell. It looks like you need to build another disguise.
npc.lokur.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.lokur.say_1: Your weekly ticket is still valid. Would be a waste of money to purchase a second one
npc.lokur.say_2: Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
npc.lokur.say_4: Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.lokur.say_6: Come on, I have no clue what they are. Better ask my armorer Kroox for such nonsense.Go and ask him for good ol' Lokurs measurements, he'll know.
npc.lokur.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.lorbas.say_1: You want me to eat this cookie?
npc.lorbas.say_2: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.lorbas.say_3: Well, you don't mind if I play around with this antidote rune a bit ... UHHH, YOU LOU ... uhm that was so ... funny, haha ... ha. Mhm, you better leave now.
npc.lorek.stdmod_1: Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.lorek.stdmod_3: I heard he is some scary magician or so.
npc.lorek.stdmod_4: I can travel you to west, centre, darama, chor or banuta.
npc.lorietta.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.lorietta.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_11: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_12: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_13: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_14: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_15: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_16: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_17: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_18: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_19: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_20: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_21: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_22: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_23: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_25:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.lorietta.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.lothar.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my humble hut, |PLAYERNAME|. What brings you {here}?
npc.lothar.multi_1: The stampor in the back? She's my friend, but she came to me out of her own free will. I must admit I've never managed to tame any other stampor. ...
npc.lothar.multi_2: I heard that there's some sort of voodoo magic which would allow you to summon a stampor, but I'm not a voodoo expert, so I wouldn't know.
npc.lothar.multi_3: It is said that ferocious creatures once thrived on lush islands in the far northern sea. They died aeons ago when times of great cold came and formed the icy wastes of Svargrond as we know them today. ...
npc.lothar.multi_4: Travellers from the north have told stories of these creatures, watching them from within the ice in the deepest caves, still vigilant as if frozen in time. 'Ursagrodon' they called them. ...
npc.lothar.multi_5: With tinder and some kind of fireproof vessel, you could create a device to melt the ice surrounding their remains and see for yourself what this is all about.
npc.lothar.multi_6: Did you know that you can also create those by yourself? Trade a gold ingot with the sweaty cyclops in Ab'Dendriel for a cup of molten gold. If you use that on a fir tree, you have a small chance to get a golden fir cone. ...
npc.lothar.multi_7: Those are needed to impress the white deers that roam around Ab'Dendriel sometimes, but I'd wait until you are able to enrage one to make sure it has the necessary strength to carry you.
npc.lothar.multi_8: That's an interesting one, nothing like I have ever seen myself. What you describe is a device of which I heard that it grants literally 'complete' control over some sort of... artificial thing? ...
npc.lothar.multi_9: Well, if you ever happen to come about a stroke of luck and find such a thing - use it on an appropriate mount, it will probably be mechanical, driven by... something.
npc.lothar.stdmod_1: I enjoy the peace and solitude out here. You're welcome to be my guest as long as you behave in a quiet and tolerable manner.
npc.lothar.stdmod_10: I heard that terror birds really love carrots. I'd try waving it in front of one of those.
npc.lothar.stdmod_11: Ah, what a pretty ribbon. Reminds me of the elusive dragonlings - they're quite elegant and vain. They would probably welcome a decorative element. They're sometimes spotted during volcano eruptions.
npc.lothar.stdmod_12: What a neat little elvish gadget. Did you know a diapason works with vibrations to create sound? I actually think this could work on a creature made of crystals.
npc.lothar.stdmod_13: I'm against violence towards any creature. I've heard those barbarians in the desert use it for disobedient dromedaries.
npc.lothar.stdmod_14: Oh, what a nice little plant! Did you know it's supposed to bring luck? So is the lady bug. Both of them might actually go well together.
npc.lothar.stdmod_15: I've heard that there once was a gang of manta ray riders who liked to adorn their mantas with a foxtail. Don't ask me why, maybe they like how it floats in the wind when running really fast?
npc.lothar.stdmod_16: What a strange device! This looks like a tool for someone who creates golems and modifies living creatures. You could probably tame a modded creature with it, but I doubt they live in the wild.
npc.lothar.stdmod_17: Oh, that's one of the favourite foods of a crustacea gigantica. I think you can just distract it with the food and quickly jump on its back.
npc.lothar.stdmod_18: Have you ever encountered a magma crawler? They only eat and drink really hot things. You could probably try and make one drink some glow wine - and quickly mount it as long as it's drunk.
npc.lothar.stdmod_19: Hm. What an interesting find. This is definitely not used for any sort of animal. Maybe a vehicle? I can imagine it could be used for a bike of some sorts.
npc.lothar.stdmod_2: Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_20: That looks like it might fit a draptor. If you can ever get close enough to one to catch it, I'd simply try putting it on while whispering calming words.
npc.lothar.stdmod_21: The sound of a hunting horn is often intimidating to forest creatures, but I heard that wild boars actually like it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_22: Ironblights consist mainly of stone and iron. With a strong magnet like that you can basically force it to walk in the direction you're wanting it to.
npc.lothar.stdmod_23: Try catching a midnight panther using that one. Don't hit the panther, mind you. Just let the whip crack in the air - I think that will work.
npc.lothar.stdmod_24: As far as I know, leeches can be found in terrestrial, swampy areas. Leeches often help large animals such as water buffaloes to get rid of parasites.
npc.lothar.stdmod_25: You should show that giant jaw to a creature looking like the one you got it from. It will respect you when it sees those scary teeth.
npc.lothar.stdmod_26: Where did you get that? What a rare treat. This must have been crafted by someone who truly loves both music and animals. I can't tell you anything else about it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_27: Oh, a nail case..., I hate paring nails. But I heard gravediggers become trusting when they get the right treatment.
npc.lothar.stdmod_28: How impressive, a nightmare horn. Have you ever encountered a shock head? Try hypnotizing them with your horn.
npc.lothar.stdmod_29: You could probably ride a black sheep with these. Talk to it gently and carefully put on the reins.
npc.lothar.stdmod_3: Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_30: Wow, that's a rarity. Have you ever met one of those large sandstone scorpions? They're quite impressive. You need such a sceptre to show to one that you're its new master.
npc.lothar.stdmod_31: That might be the only way to tame a bear. It has a sensitive spot right between the ears which will calm it down, but you're not strong enough for simple acupressure. Using the slingshot is likely to help you with that.
npc.lothar.stdmod_32: As the name indicates - this can be used to make a slug much faster than it normally is! Once you've tamed it, it will race you wherever you want to go.
npc.lothar.stdmod_33: Create sugar oat by just mixing a bunch of sugar cane with a bunch of wheat. All horses love sugar oat! Sometimes when the horses from the horse station in Thais are on the loose, wild horses mix with the herd. Maybe they can be tamed?
npc.lothar.stdmod_34: The interesting part about that bait isn't the sweet stuff - it's the flies attracted to the sweet smell. Spiders love to eat flies, especially the Zaoan ones.
npc.lothar.stdmod_35: Hm! Now that's an interesting one. Where did you get that from? I could imagine it winds something up in a factory, but it's definitely not a normal animal.
npc.lothar.stdmod_4: I love all animals, whether small or big. I also believe each one, even the wildest and most ferocious being, can be talked to, understood and {tamed}.
npc.lothar.stdmod_5: It's my dream to shelter many different tamed animals. Maybe one day that dream will come true.
npc.lothar.stdmod_6: Well, usually you can tame animals with the help of a few simple items. If you've found such an {item}, show it to me and I might be able to help you with instructions on the taming process.
npc.lothar.stdmod_7: Well? Which item have you found and require advice for?
npc.lothar.stdmod_8: That's among the favourite foods of donkeys, as far as I know. It's a shame I haven't really seen any donkey around. It could require a magic trick to actually get to meet one.
npc.lothar.stdmod_9: Pandas love to eat bamboo leaves, but the Tiquandan pandas are actually not that skilled at climbing, so they have a hard time getting some for themselves. You might be able to tame one with them.
npc.lothar.voice_1: I enjoy the peace and solitude out here. You're welcome to be my guest as long as you behave in a quiet and tolerable manner.
npc.loui.farewell_msg_1: May the gods protect you! And stay away from that hole!
npc.loui.stdmod_10: They were so many, EVERYWHERE! I could barely escape alive. I have no clue what THEY were but one more second down there and I'd have been dead!
npc.loui.stdmod_11: Sorry, I'm out of mana and ingredients, please visit Cipfried in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_12: The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_13: Everything around us, that is Tibia.
npc.loui.stdmod_14: Most adventurers take their first steps there.
npc.loui.stdmod_15: Pah, king! He should do something about this {hole}!
npc.loui.stdmod_16: This is the place where everything starts.
npc.loui.stdmod_17: Was it...? Yes, I might have looked for blueberries as I foolishly entered this unholy {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_18: There must be an army of them, just down this {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_19: Then, they must be magic wielding beasts using creature illusion! Good thing you escaped.
npc.loui.stdmod_20: The gods blessed Tibia with abundant forms of life.
npc.loui.stdmod_21: The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_22: I have no quests but to stay away from that {hole} and I recommend you to do the same.
npc.loui.stdmod_23: I'm penniless and poor as becomes a humble monk like me.
npc.loui.stdmod_24: She owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_25: She owns a bar in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_26: Waaaah! Don't shock me like that!
npc.loui.stdmod_27: He has his own monsters, I believe.
npc.loui.stdmod_29: He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_3: What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!
npc.loui.stdmod_30: Who's that? Never heard about her.
npc.loui.stdmod_31: He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_33: The gods may protect me from his rudeness.
npc.loui.stdmod_34: A hermit on the other side of town.
npc.loui.stdmod_35: The oracle! Yes! You should get off this island as fast as you can!
npc.loui.stdmod_5: I'm a {monk}. I wanted to do something here, but I forgot what it was when I fell in that {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_6: I'm a humble servant of the {gods}.
npc.loui.stdmod_7: They created Tibia and all lifeforms.
npc.loui.stdmod_8: I have no idea how long I've been in this {hole}. It seemed like an eternity!
npc.loui.stdmod_9: While looking for something - which I forgot - I found that {hole}. I went down, even though I had no torch. And then I heard {THEM}! There must be dozens!
npc.loui.voice_3: What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!
npc.lubo.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my adventurer shop, |PLAYERNAME|! What do you need? Ask me for a {trade} to look at my wares.
npc.lubo.say_1: Sorry, the backpack I wear is not for sale. It's handmade from rare minotaur leather.
npc.lubo.say_10: Great! Alright, I need a while to finish this backpack for you. Come ask me later, okay?
npc.lubo.say_11: I know, it's quite some work... don't lose heart, just keep killing minotaurs and you'll eventually get lucky. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?
npc.lubo.say_12: Ah yes, I remember my grandfather talking about that name. This house used to be an inn a long time ago. My family bought it from some of these flower guys.
npc.lubo.say_13: Oh, I mean druids of course. They sold the cottage to my family after some of them died in an accident or something like that.
npc.lubo.say_14: As far as I can remember the story, a pet escaped its stable behind the inn. It got somehow involved with powerful magic at a ritual and was transformed in some way.
npc.lubo.say_15: My grandpa told me, in the old days there were some behind this cottage. Nothing big though, just small ones, for chicken or rabbits.
npc.lubo.say_2: Ah, right, almost forgot about the backpack! Have you brought me 100 pieces of minotaur leather as requested?
npc.lubo.say_3: Just in time! Your backpack is finished. Here you go, I hope you like it.
npc.lubo.say_4: Uh... I didn't expect you to return that early. Sorry, but I'm not finished yet with your backpack. I'm doing the best I can, promised.
npc.lubo.say_5: Sorry, but I can only make one backpack per person, else I'd have to close my shop and open a leather manufactory.
npc.lubo.say_6: Well, if you really like this backpack, I could make one for you, but minotaur leather is hard to come by these days. Are you willing to put some work into this?
npc.lubo.say_7: Alright then, if you bring me 100 pieces of fine minotaur leather I will see what I can do for you. You probably have to kill really many minotaurs though... so good luck!
npc.lubo.say_8: Sorry, but I don't run a welfare office, you know... no pain, no gain.
npc.lubo.say_9: Sorry, but that's not enough leather yet to make one of these backpacks. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?
npc.lubo.stdmod_1: Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!
npc.lubo.stdmod_2: I am selling equipment for adventurers. If you need anything, let me know.
npc.lubo.stdmod_3: This is Ruffy my dog, please don't do him any harm.
npc.lubo.stdmod_4: I sell torches, fishing rods, worms, ropes, water hoses, backpacks, apples, and maps.
npc.lubo.stdmod_5: I am Lubo, the owner of this shop.
npc.lubo.stdmod_6: Oh! I'm sorry, I sold the last one just five minutes ago.
npc.lubo.stdmod_7: My hat? Hanna made this one for me.
npc.lubo.stdmod_8: Oh, you sure mean this old story about the mage Dago, who lost two fingers when he conjured a dragon.
npc.lubo.voice_1: Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!
npc.lugri.multi_1: You do? I mean - wise decision. Let me explain. By now, Tibia has been overrun by numerous followers of different cults and beliefs. The true Necromancers died or left Tibia long ago, shortly after their battle was lost. ...
npc.lugri.multi_10: What? Who are you to imply I need help from a worm like you? ...
npc.lugri.multi_11: I don't need help. But if you desperately wish to do something to earn the favour of Zathroth, feel free. Don't expect any reward though. ...
npc.lugri.multi_12: Do you want to help and serve Zathroth out of your own free will, without demanding payment or recognition?
npc.lugri.multi_2: What is left are mainly pseudo-dark pretenders, the old wisdom and power being far beyond their grasp. They think they have the right to tap that dark power, but they don't. ...
npc.lugri.multi_3: I want you to eliminate them. As many as you can. All of the upstart necromancer orders, and those priestesses. And as I said, don't expect a reward - this is what has to be done to cleanse Tibia of its false dark prophets.
npc.lugri.multi_4: Hrm. So you had the guts to enter that room. Well, it's all fake magic anyway and no real threat. ...
npc.lugri.multi_5: What are you looking at me for? Waiting for something? I told you that there was no reward. Despite being allowed to stand before me without being squashed like a bug. Get out of my sight!
npc.lugri.multi_7: necromancers and priestesses. Still, you've shown some dedication. Maybe that means you can kill one of those so-called 'leaders' too. ...
npc.lugri.multi_8: Deep under Drefia, a necromancer called Necropharus is hiding in the Halls of Sacrifice. I'll place a spell on you with which you will be able to pass his weak protective gate. ...
npc.lugri.multi_9: Know that this will be your only chance to enter his room. If you leave it or die, you won't be able to return. We'll see if you really dare enter those halls.
npc.lugri.say_1: This skull shows that you are a true follower of Zathroth and the glorious gods of darkness. Are you willing to prove your loyalty?
npc.lugri.say_10: It will be a hard task which requires many sacrifices. Do you still want to proceed?
npc.lugri.say_11: Good decision, |PLAYERNAME|. Your first sacrifice will be a medusa shield. Bring it to me and do give it happily.
npc.lugri.say_12: Good. I accept your sacrifice. The second sacrifice I require from you is a dragon scale mail. Bring it to me and do give it happily.
npc.lugri.say_14: Good. I accept your sacrifice. The third sacrifice I require from you are crown legs. Bring them to me and do give them happily.
npc.lugri.say_16: Good. I accept your sacrifice. The last sacrifice I require from you is a ring of the sky. Bring it to me and do give it happily.
npc.lugri.say_18: Good. I accept your sacrifice. You have proven that you are a true follower of Zathroth and do not hesitate to sacrifice worldly goods. Thus, I will reward you with this headgear.

npc.lugri.say_49: You do? I mean - wise decision. Let me explain. By now, Tibia has been overrun by numerous followers of different cults and beliefs. The true Necromancers died or left Tibia long ago, shortly after their battle was lost. ...
npc.lugri.say_5: Is it your true wish to sacrifice a ring of the sky to Zathroth?
npc.lugri.say_50: What is left are mainly pseudo-dark pretenders, the old wisdom and power being far beyond their grasp. They think they have the right to tap that dark power, but they don't. ...
npc.lugri.say_51: I want you to eliminate them. As many as you can. All of the upstart necromancer orders, and those priestesses. And as I said, don't expect a reward - this is what has to be done to cleanse Tibia of its false dark prophets.
npc.lugri.say_6: Come back when you have slain 4000 necromancers and priestesses!
npc.lugri.say_8: Come back when you have slain 1000 necromancers and priestesses!
npc.lugri.say_9: You can't live without serving, can you? Although you are quite annoying, you're still somewhat useful. Continue killing Necromancers and Priestesses for me. 1000 are enough this time. What do you say?
npc.lukosch.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
npc.lukosch.say_1: Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
npc.lukosch.say_2: Your weekly ticket is still valid. Would be a waste of money to purchase a second one
npc.lukosch.say_3: Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.luna.greet_msg_1: Greetings, traveller. Maybe you'd like to take a look at my {offers}...
npc.luna.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.luna.stdmod_1: Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!
npc.luna.voice_1: Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!
npc.lurik.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the {explorer society} headquarter of Svargrond, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.lurik.multi_1: Now we're talking! Maybe you've already heard of the island Okolnir south of Hrodmir. ...
npc.lurik.multi_10: We need you to recover this crystal. Travel to the southern camp of the raiders and find our contact man there. Get the memory crystal and bring ithere. The society and the shamans will then decide our next steps. Do you think you can do this?
npc.lurik.multi_11: Ah! You did it! I can't wait to hear the sound... but I will do that in a silent moment. ...
npc.lurik.multi_12: You helped as much in our research here. As a reward, you may use our astral portal in the upper room from now on. ...
npc.lurik.multi_13: For just one orichalcum pearl, you can travel between Liberty Bay and Svargrond. Thank you again!
npc.lurik.multi_14: Ah, yes, the mission. Let me tell you about something called ice music. ...
npc.lurik.multi_15: There is a cave on Hrodmir, north of the southernmost barbarian camp Krimhorn. ...
npc.lurik.multi_16: In this cave, there are a waterfall and a lot of stalagmites. ...
npc.lurik.multi_17: When the wind blows into this cave and hits the stalagmites, it is supposed to create a sound similar to a soft song. ...
npc.lurik.multi_18: Please take this resonance crystal and use it on the stalagmites in the cave to record the sound of the wind.
npc.lurik.multi_19: A frozen dragon lord? This is just the information we needed! And you even brought a scale from it! Take these 5000 gold pieces as a reward. ...
npc.lurik.multi_2: Okolnir is the home of a new and fierce dragon race, the so-called frost dragons. However, we have no idea where they originate from. ...
npc.lurik.multi_20: As you did such a great job, I might have another mission for you later.
npc.lurik.multi_3: Rumours say that dragon lords, that roamed on this isle, were somehow turned into frost dragons when the great frost covered Okolnir. ...
npc.lurik.multi_4: Travel to Okolnir and try to find a proof for the existence of dragon lords there in the old times. I think old Buddel might be able to bring you there.
npc.lurik.multi_5: The information was quite useful. What worries me most are not the raiders but those that have driven them from the old mines...
npc.lurik.multi_6: We need to investigate the mines. Most entrances collapsed due to the lack of maintenance but there should be some possibilities to get in ...
npc.lurik.multi_7: In case you find a door, Ill tell you the old trick of the Carlin mining company to open it <whisper> <whisper>. Find some hint or someone who is willing to talk about what is going on there.
npc.lurik.multi_8: You are the one who became an honorary barbarian! The one who made friends with the grim local musher and helped the shamans of Nibelor! The one they call old bearhugg ... erm ... I mean indeed I might have a mission for someone like you ...
npc.lurik.multi_9: We are trying to find out what is happening in the raider camps. Through our connection to the shamans we could get a covered contact in their majorcamp far to the south. We equipped our contact with a memory crystal so he could report all he knew ...
npc.lurik.say_1: Ah, you've just come in time. An experienced explorer is just what we need here! Would you like to go on a mission for us?
npc.lurik.say_3: Have you retrieved the memory crystal?
npc.lurik.say_5: Excellent. Just report about your mission when you got the memory crystal.
npc.lurik.say_6: Ah, great. Please give me some time to evaluate the information. Then talk to me again about your mission.
npc.lynda.greet_msg_1: Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.lynda.multi_1: Thank you, I promise that your efforts won't be in vain! Listen closely now: First, I need a sample of five druid rods and five sorcerer wands. ...
npc.lynda.multi_10: Will you gather them for me?
npc.lynda.multi_2: I need a snakebite rod, a moonlight rod, a necrotic rod, a terra rod and a hailstorm rod. Then, I need a wand of vortex, a wand of dragonbreath ...
npc.lynda.multi_3: ... a wand of decay, a wand of cosmic energy and a wand of inferno. Please bring them all at once so that their energy will be balanced. ...
npc.lynda.multi_4: Secondly, I need 10 ounces of magic sulphur. It can absorb the elemental energy of all the wands and rods and bind it to something else. ...
npc.lynda.multi_5: Next, I will need a soul stone. These can be used as a vessel for energy, evil as well as good. They are rarely used nowaday though. ...
npc.lynda.multi_6: Lastly, I need a lot of holy energy. I can extract it from ankhs, but only a small amount each time. I will need about 20 ankhs. ...
npc.lynda.multi_7: Did you understand everything I told you and will help me with my blessing?
npc.lynda.multi_8: Angelina had been imprisoned? My, these are horrible news, but I am so glad to hear that she is safe now. ...
npc.lynda.multi_9: I will happily carry out her wish and reward you, but I fear I need some important ingredients for my blessing spell first. ...
npc.lynda.say_10: [EN] *After a whispered blessing opens an hand towards {}* Take these two engraved wedding rings and give one of them to your spouse.
npc.lynda.say_11: [EN] You may now kiss your bride.
npc.lynda.say_12: Are you sure you want to remove your wedding proposal with {{}}?
npc.lynda.say_13: Are you sure you want to divorce of {{}}?

npc.lynda.say_15: Since both of you are willing to marry, I accept to celebrate your marriage, go prepare yourself, and tell me when you are ready for the {celebration}
npc.lynda.say_16: Your partner didn't accept your proposal, yet
npc.lynda.say_18: You don't have any pending proposal to be removed.

npc.lynda.say_20: You aren't married to get a divorce.
npc.lynda.say_21: Through their time together, they have come to realize that their personal dreams, hopes, and goals are more attainable and more meaningful through the combined effort and mutual support provided in love, commitment, and family;
npc.lynda.say_22: and so they have decided to live together as husband and wife. And now, by the power vested in me by the Gods of Tibia, I hereby pronounce you husband and wife.
npc.lynda.say_23: You may now kiss your bride.

npc.lynda.say_26: Will you gather them for me?

npc.lynda.say_28: Did you obtain 10 ounces of magic sulphur?
npc.lynda.say_29: Were you actually able to retrieve the Necromancer's soul stone?
npc.lynda.say_30: Am I sensing enough holy energy from ankhs here?
npc.lynda.say_31: I'm glad to tell you that I have finished the ritual, player. Here is your new wand. I hope you carry it proudly for everyone to see..
npc.lynda.say_32: Please let me focus for a while, |PLAYERNAME|.

npc.lynda.say_40: Alright then. Come back to with a sample of all five wands and five rods, please.
npc.lynda.say_41: Thank you, that must have been a lot to carry. Now, please bring me 10 ounces of magic sulphur.
npc.lynda.say_42: Very good. I will immediately start to prepare the ritual and extract the elemental energy from the wands and rods. Please bring me the Necromancer's soul stone now.
npc.lynda.say_43: You have found a rarity there, |PLAYERNAME|. This will become the tip of your blessed wand. Please bring me 20 ankhs now to complete the ritual.
npc.lynda.say_44: The ingredients for the ritual are complete! I will start to prepare your blessed wand, but I have to medidate first. Please come back later to hear how the ritual went.

npc.maealil.greet_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.maealil.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.maealil.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.maealil.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.maealil.stdmod_11: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake.
npc.maealil.stdmod_12: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.maealil.stdmod_13: So receive my prayer: 'Peace may fill your soul - evil shall be cleansed'. Now, bring your stake to Yberius in the Venore temple for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.maealil.stdmod_15: You should visit Yberius in the Venore temple now.
npc.maealil.stdmod_16: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.maealil.stdmod_17: A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.maealil.stdmod_18: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.maealil.stdmod_19: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.maealil.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.maealil.stdmod_20: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.maealil.stdmod_21: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.maealil.stdmod_22: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.maealil.stdmod_23: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.maealil.stdmod_24: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.maealil.stdmod_25: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.maealil.stdmod_26: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.maealil.stdmod_27: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.maealil.stdmod_28: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.maealil.stdmod_29: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.maealil.stdmod_30: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.maealil.stdmod_34:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.maealil.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.maealil.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.maealil.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.maealil.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.maelyrra.farewell_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.maelyrra.greet_msg_1: Nature's blessings! Welcome to the land of dreams.
npc.maelyrra.multi_1: That's wonderful! Now you will be able to repair the magical barrier. You have to strengthen the arcane sources that power this mystic shield. There are three different arcane sources: the moon sculptures, the dream bird trees and the sun mosaics. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_10: They are living in tunnels and caves but at night they surface, even attacking their own siblings. They kidnapped some fairies, holding them prisoner in their mouldy dens. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_11: And as if this wasn't enough they stole an ancient and precious artefact, the moon mirror. Please seek out the tainted fae, retrieve the artefact and free the captured fairies. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_12: You may discover the entrance to the tainted caves somewhere in the deep forest. The tainted fae like to hide their treasures in hollow logs or trumps, so have a closer look at them.
npc.maelyrra.multi_2: There are five of each of them and you have to find them all to repair the barrier. Spread the gathered moon rays on the moon sculptures. Pour out the starlight over the dream bird trees and let the sunlight shine on the mosaics. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_3: If you charge all fifteen arcane sources with the respective light, Feyrist's protection will be ensured again.
npc.maelyrra.multi_4: Very good, mortal being! Now you have to catch the respective light and store it in the corresponding vessel. You can gather moon rays by night but this will only work on one special sacred glade on Feyrist. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_5: You can find this glade in the deep forest, east of our village. The starlight must also be gathered by night. There is a rock plateau high in the mountains at the border to Roshamuul where you can catch the starlight in the vial. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_6: You will recognise the place by the elemental energy shrine there. You have to gather the sunlight by day, of course. There is a beach in the north of Feyrist, shaped like a snake's head. There you may gather Suon's light with the sun catcher.
npc.maelyrra.multi_7: You have to find three vessels that are able to hold three different types of light: starlight, sunlight and moon rays. You have already found the moon mirror but we also need the starlight vial and the sun catcher. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_8: Ask the mermaid Aurita for the starlight vial and the faun Taegen for the sun catcher.
npc.maelyrra.multi_9: Some of our siblings are tainted by the destructive energies that threaten Feyrist. They are darker now, more aggressive, twisted ... I'm sure you already met them. ...
npc.maelyrra.say_1: Some annoying nightmarish creatures rove about in the tunnels underneath this island. They are threatening the members of my court and devastate the flora and fauna. They also threaten the natural balance. Would you go and fight them for me?
npc.maelyrra.say_10: You rendered a great favour to the fae courts and Feyrist alike. Would you help us with another problem?
npc.maelyrra.say_11: You have to kill two hundred of nightmare creatures and the terrible demon Kroazur who's leading them. That should bring some relief for the fae.
npc.maelyrra.say_12: Thank you, mortal being! Please keep the mirror. I think you may need it soon, because there is another problem. Would you help us again?
npc.maelyrra.say_13: Please keep the mirror. I think you may need it soon, because there is another problem. Would you help us again?
npc.maelyrra.say_14: Please seek out the tainted fae, retrieve the artefact and free the captured fairies.
npc.maelyrra.say_15: You have to catch the respective lights and store it in the corresponding vessel.
npc.maelyrra.say_16: Thank you, mortal being! The fae will be forever grateful. Take this blossom bag as a little thank-you gift. Such blossoms grow on our trees just once in a decade, so they are quite rare.
npc.maelyrra.say_17: If you charge all fifteen arcane sources with the respective light, Feyrist's protection will be ensured again.
npc.maelyrra.say_2: Have you defeated the nightmare monsters?
npc.maelyrra.say_3: Have you found the moon mirror and freed the captured fairies?
npc.maelyrra.say_4: Have you already found the starlight vial and the sun catcher?
npc.maelyrra.say_5: Could you already gather the three lights?
npc.maelyrra.say_6: Have you repaired the magical barrier? Is Feyrist safe?
npc.maelyrra.say_7: Thank you again, mortal being! The fae will be forever grateful.
npc.maelyrra.say_8: I knew you would be willing to help us. Kill two hundred of them as well as the terrible demon Kroazur who's leading them. That should bring some relief for the fae.
npc.maelyrra.say_9: Thank you! You rendered a great favour to the fae courts and Feyrist alike. Would you help us with another problem?
npc.maelyrra.walkaway_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.maeryn.greet_msg_1: Greetings, visitor. I wonder what may lead you to this {dangerous} place.
npc.maeryn.multi_1: Every month around the 13th, the single Tibian moon will by fully visible to us. That's when the curse hits us hardest. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_10: Those merely wounded, first thought they were lucky. But then we realised they were changing, too. Later, others assumed the forms of badgers and boars also. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_11: But that does not mean they were any less wild or dangerous than the others.
npc.maeryn.multi_2: We do not know what happens down there in those tunnels around that time but there is a presence there, we all feel - yet cannot quite fathom. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_3: At full moon, humans transform into wild beasts: wolves, boars, bears and others. Some call it the {curse} of the Full Moon, others think it is a kind of sickness. .
npc.maeryn.multi_4: During this time, we try to not leave the house, we shut the windows and hope it will pass. The curse will weaken a bit after that but it returns. Every month.
npc.maeryn.multi_5: During this time, we try to not leave the house, we shut the windows and hope it will pass. The curse will weaken a bit after that but it returns. Every month.
npc.maeryn.multi_6: We are not sure what they are doing down there. We're glad if they stay in the caverns and leave us alone. Only at full moon do they come up and threaten the island's surface and village. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_7: I, however, have a {hunch} as to why they dwell so deep under the earth.
npc.maeryn.multi_8: It transforms peaceful villagers into savage beasts. We're not sure how this curse found the way into our small village. But one day it began. At first it befell just a few people. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_9: In a full moon night they changed into bears and wolves, and tore apart their unsuspecting relatives while they were asleep. ...
npc.maeryn.say_10: I'm the protector of this little village. A bit of a self-proclaimed function, I admit, but someone has to watch over {Grimvale}. It is a {dangerous} place.
npc.maeryn.say_11: The small island you are standing on. For a long time it was a peaceful and placid place. But lately it has become more {dangerous}.
npc.maeryn.say_12: He's an experienced hunter and knows much about the woods, the animals that dwell there, and about the {werewolves}. He's devoted himself to finding out everything there is to know about the {Curse}.
npc.maeryn.say_13: Yes, my friend, werewolves. They dwell here on {Grimvale}, threatening our life. The were-sickness transforms peaceful villagers into savage beasts. We're not sure how this curse found its way into our small village. But undoubtedly it did.
npc.maeryn.say_14: She's an old druid. She's been living here on {Grimvale} since she was a little girl, just like me. She's very interested in were-creature body parts. If you find any, I'm sure she will love to trade with you.
npc.maeryn.say_15: He's basically a ferryman nowadays, but I remember when he was our village's leading fisherman. He offers a ferry service between Grimvale and Edron. You must have met him - he sailed you here.
npc.maeryn.say_16: You brought the wolven helmet, as i see. Do you want to change something?
npc.maeryn.say_17: So, which profession would you give preference to when enchanting the helmet: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {druid} or {paladin}?
npc.maeryn.say_18: And what would be your preferred weapon? {Club}, {axe} or {sword}
npc.maeryn.say_19: So this is your choice. If you want to change it, you will have to come to me again.
npc.maeryn.say_2: Yes, pitiful. For they are savage beasts now who regularly come up from below to attack the village. But once they were inhabitants of Grimvale, before they {changed}.
npc.maeryn.say_20: Message when player do not have quest.
npc.maeryn.say_21: So this is your choice. If you want to change it, you will have to come to me again.
npc.maeryn.say_22: Message when player do not have quest.
npc.maeryn.say_23: So you don't know it yet. This island, Grimvale, is affected by were-sickness. Many {pitiful}, who are stricken with the curse, dwell in the {tunnels} and caverns underneath the village and the nearby hurst.
npc.maeryn.say_24: Yes, pitiful. For they are savage beasts now who regularly come up from below to attack the village. But once they were inhabitants of Grimvale, before they {changed}.
npc.maeryn.say_25: Through a bite or even a scratch, you may be infected with the were-sickness. If that happens, there is little {hope} - until the next full moon you'll change into a were-creature, depending on the animal that hurt you.
npc.maeryn.say_26: There is a plant, the purple nightshade. It blossoms exclusively in the light of the full moon and only underground, where the full moon's light is falling through fissures in the surface. Only this plant's blossoms are able to defeat the {were-sickness}.
npc.maeryn.say_27: It transforms peaceful villagers into savage beasts. We're not sure how this curse found the way into our small village. But one day it began. At first it befell just a few people. ...
npc.maeryn.say_28: In a full moon night they changed into bears and wolves, and tore apart their unsuspecting relatives while they were asleep. ...
npc.maeryn.say_29: Those merely wounded, first thought they were lucky. But then we realised they were changing, too. Later, others assumed the forms of badgers and boars also. ...
npc.maeryn.say_3: Through a bite or even a scratch, you may be infected with the were-sickness. If that happens, there is little {hope} - until the next full moon you'll change into a were-creature, depending on the animal that hurt you.
npc.maeryn.say_30: But that does not mean they were any less wild or dangerous than the others.
npc.maeryn.say_31: We are not sure what they are doing down there. We're glad if they stay in the caverns and leave us alone. Only at full moon do they come up and threaten the island's surface and village. ...
npc.maeryn.say_32: I, however, have a {hunch} as to why they dwell so deep under the earth.
npc.maeryn.say_33: There are old legends about a subterranean temple that was once built in this area. Supposedly many {artefacts} are still hidden down there. ...
npc.maeryn.say_34: I don't have the time to tell you the entire tale, but there is a book downstairs in which you may read the whole story.
npc.maeryn.say_35: Yes, the story goes that there are ancient artefacts still hidden in the temple ruins, such as helmets in the form of wolven heads, for example. It is said that moonlight crystals are needed to enchant these artefacts.
npc.maeryn.say_36: Every month around the 13th, the single Tibian moon will by fully visible to us. That's when the curse hits us hardest. ...
npc.maeryn.say_37: The two days around the 13th, the 12th and the 14th, are considered 'Harvest Moon', those are the best to gather {nightshade}. However, only after it has reached its apex on the 13th, the curse strengthens. ...
npc.maeryn.say_38: We do not know what happens down there in those tunnels around that time but there is a presence there, we all feel - yet cannot quite fathom. ...
npc.maeryn.say_39: At full moon, humans transform into wild beasts: wolves, boars, bears and others. Some call it the {curse} of the Full Moon, others think it is a kind of sickness. .
npc.maeryn.say_4: There is a plant, the purple nightshade. It blossoms exclusively in the light of the full moon and only underground, where the full moon's light is falling through fissures in the surface. Only this plant's blossoms are able to defeat the {were-sickness}.
npc.maeryn.say_40: During this time, we try to not leave the house, we shut the windows and hope it will pass. The curse will weaken a bit after that but it returns. Every month.
npc.maeryn.say_41: Three of these blossoms should suffice to heal some afflicted persons. But if you bring more I'd be grateful, of course.
npc.maeryn.say_45: I'm the protector of this little village. A bit of a self-proclaimed function, I admit, but someone has to watch over {Grimvale}. It is a {dangerous} place.
npc.maeryn.say_46: The small island you are standing on. For a long time it was a peaceful and placid place. But lately it has become more {dangerous}.
npc.maeryn.say_47: He's an experienced hunter and knows much about the woods, the animals that dwell there, and about the {werewolves}. He's devoted himself to finding out everything there is to know about the {Curse}.
npc.maeryn.say_48: Yes, my friend, werewolves. They dwell here on {Grimvale}, threatening our life. The were-sickness transforms peaceful villagers into savage beasts. We're not sure how this curse found its way into our small village. But undoubtedly it did.
npc.maeryn.say_49: She's an old druid. She's been living here on {Grimvale} since she was a little girl, just like me. She's very interested in were-creature body parts. If you find any, I'm sure she will love to trade with you.
npc.maeryn.say_5: There are old legends about a subterranean temple that was once built in this area. Supposedly many {artefacts} are still hidden down there. ...
npc.maeryn.say_50: He's basically a ferryman nowadays, but I remember when he was our village's leading fisherman. He offers a ferry service between Grimvale and Edron. You must have met him - he sailed you here.
npc.maeryn.say_51: You brought the wolven helmet, as i see. Do you want to change something?
npc.maeryn.say_52: So, which profession would you give preference to when enchanting the helmet: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {druid} or {paladin}?
npc.maeryn.say_53: And what would be your preferred weapon? {Club}, {axe} or {sword}
npc.maeryn.say_54: So this is your choice. If you want to change it, you will have to come to me again.
npc.maeryn.say_55: So this is your choice. If you want to change it, you will have to come to me again.
npc.maeryn.say_6: Yes, the story goes that there are ancient artefacts still hidden in the temple ruins, such as helmets in the form of wolven heads, for example. It is said that moonlight crystals are needed to enchant these artefacts.
npc.maeryn.say_7: Three of these blossoms should suffice to heal some afflicted persons. But if you bring more I'd be grateful, of course.
npc.maeryn.voice_1: Not enough purple nightshade ... not enough liquid silver. *sigh*
npc.maeryn.voice_2: You think the full moon is a romantic affair? Think again!
npc.maeryn.voice_3: This place isn't safe. You should leave this island.
npc.malor.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, human. When I have taken my rightful place I shall remember those who served me well. Even if they are only humans.
npc.malor.multi_1: You've met Fahim the Wise? That's good. I'm pretty sure it was easy to give him a nice beating. ...
npc.malor.multi_10: But that's in the future. For now, I will confine myself to give you the permission to trade with my people whenever you want to. ...
npc.malor.multi_12: Well, listen. We are trying to acquire the ultimate weapon to defeat Gabel: Fa'hradin's lamp! ...
npc.malor.multi_13: At the moment it is still in the possession of that good old friend of mine, the Orc King, who kindly released me from it. ...
npc.malor.multi_14: However, for some reason he is not as friendly as he used to be. You better watch out, human, because I don't think you will get the lamp without a fight. ...
npc.malor.multi_15: Once you have found the lamp you must enter Ashta'daramai again. Sneak into Gabel's personal chambers and exchange his sleeping lamp with Fa'hradin's lamp! ...
npc.malor.multi_16: If you succeed, the war could be over one night later!
npc.malor.multi_17: So you would like to fight for us. Hmm. ...
npc.malor.multi_18: You show true courage, human, but I will not accept your offer at this point of time.
npc.malor.multi_19: I guess this is the first time I entrust a human with a mission. And such an important mission, too. But well, we live in hard times, and I am a bit short of adequate staff. ...
npc.malor.multi_2: If you should feel like killing blue djinns in our service again, just talk to me about that task.
npc.malor.multi_20: Besides, Baa'leal told me you have distinguished yourself well in previous missions, so I think you might be the right person for the job. ...
npc.malor.multi_21: But think carefully, human, for this mission will bring you close to certain death. Are you prepared to embark on this mission?
npc.malor.multi_23: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.malor.multi_3: Well well, human. Not bad. I'm not surprised, since you have done acceptably well in the past. So I suppose I can ask you for another thing. ...
npc.malor.multi_4: Seek out Fahim the Wise. A name which is utter mockery, since he's one of the stupidest Marid I've ever seen. He hides somewhere in Yalahar, probably afraid to come anywhere near Mal'ouquah. ...
npc.malor.multi_5: I suggest you teach that joke of a djinn a lesson he won't forget.
npc.malor.multi_6: Well well, human. So you really have made it - you have smuggled the modified lamp into Gabel's bedroom! ...
npc.malor.multi_7: I never thought I would say this to a human, but I must confess I am impressed. ...
npc.malor.multi_8: Perhaps I have underestimated you and your kind after all. ...
npc.malor.multi_9: I guess I will take this as a lesson to keep in mind when I meet you on the battlefield. ...
npc.malor.say_1: Shove off, little one! Humans are not welcome here, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.malor.say_10: Good, then show those pathetic Marid what you're made of.
npc.malor.say_2: Greetings, human |PLAYERNAME|. My patience with your kind is limited, so speak quickly and choose your words well.
npc.malor.say_3: You haven't finished your final mission yet. Shall I explain it again to you?
npc.malor.say_4: Have you found Fa'hradin's lamp and placed it in Malor's personal chambers?
npc.malor.say_5: There's no mission left for you, friend of the Efreet. However, I have a {task} for you.
npc.malor.say_8: There are still blue djinns everywhere! We can't let a single one of them live. I guess a start would be for you to kill 500 blue djinns and Marid. Will you assist us?
npc.malor.say_9: Come back when you kill 500 blue djinns and Marid.
npc.malunga.greet_msg_1: Greetings. I have only little time to {spare}, so the conversation will be short. I teach sorcerer {spells} and buy a few magical {ingredients}.
npc.marina.greet_msg_1: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|. A visitor, how nice!
npc.marina.multi_1: <giggles> It's funny how easy it is to get humans to say what you want. Now, proving it will be even more fun! ...
npc.marina.multi_2: You want me to touch something gooey, so you have to touch something gooey for me too. <giggles> ...
npc.marina.multi_3: I love honey and I haven't eaten it in a while, so bring me 50 honeycombs and worship my beauty a little more, then we will see.
npc.marina.multi_4: This lovely, exotic Djinn is a true poet. And he is asking me for a date? Excellent. Now I can finaly dump this human pirate. He was growing to be boring more and more with each day ...
npc.marina.multi_5: As a little reward for your efforts I allow you to ride my sea turtles. Just look around at the shores and you will find them.
npc.marina.say_1: Um. You mean, you really want me to touch that gooey spider silk just because you need yarn? Well... do you think that I'm pretty?
npc.marina.say_10: You don't have the required items.
npc.marina.say_2: Okay... a deal is a deal, would you like me to create a {spool of yarn} from {10 pieces of spider silk}?
npc.marina.say_3: Did you bring me the 50 honeycombs I requested and do you absolutely admire my beauty?
npc.marina.say_4: <giggles> I think he has a crush on me. Well, silly man, it is only for his own good. This way he can get accustomed to TRUE beauty. And I won't give him up anymore now that he is mine.
npc.marina.say_5: Is that the best you can do? A true Djinn would have done something more poetic.
npc.marina.say_6: Well, everyone would say that in your position. Do you think that I'm really, absolutely the most stunning being that you have ever seen?
npc.marina.say_7: Oh goodie! Thank you! Okay... I guess since my fingers are sticky now anyway, I will help you. From now on, if you bring me {10 pieces of spider silk}, I will create one {spool of yarn}.
npc.marina.stdmod_1: Sorry, I don't have a spare comb. I lost my favourite one when diving around in Calassa.
npc.maris.greet_msg_1: I hope you have a good reason to step near my {ship}, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.maris.say_1: The good thing about cookies is that they last for a long time. So they are well suited for a boat trip. I'll take some of those, okay?
npc.maris.say_2: It'd be better for you to leave now.
npc.maris.say_3: Let's try that stuff first - ARRRRRRHH! <coughs> That must have been the worst cookie I've ever eaten. Get off my ship.
npc.maris.stdmod_1: Do you want go to the {0} for {1}?
npc.maris.stdmod_3: I can take you to {Fenrock} and {Mistrock}!
npc.maris.stdmod_4: I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris.stdmod_5: Stop mumbling and don't bug me.
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_1: Do you want go to {0} for {1}?
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_3: I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Mistrock}!
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_4: I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Mistrock}!
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_5: I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_6: I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_1: Do you want go to {0} for {1}?
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_3: I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Fenrock}!
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_4: I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Fenrock}!
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_5: I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_6: I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_7:
Do you smell this? It's the smell of fire... the fire of a forge. Many people searched this rock here for a hidden path, but they haven't found anything. ... \z
	I'd search on Fenrock if I were you. Even though there's snow on the surface, it's still warm underground. There are often caves under fresh lava streams.
npc.maritima.multi_1: The quara in this area are a strange race that seeks for inner perfection rather than physical one. ...
npc.maritima.multi_2: Considering that they are quara, they are rather peaceful as long no one enters their territory. ...
npc.maritima.multi_3: However, recently the quara got mad because their area is flooded with toxic sewage from the city. If you could inform someone about it, they might stop the sewage and the quara could return to their own business.
npc.markwin.greet_msg_2: Well ... you defeated my guards! Now everything is over! I guess I will have to answer your questions now.
npc.markwin.say_1: No! The hornless have reached my city! BODYGUARDS TO ME!
npc.markwin.say_2: A letter from my Moohmy?? Do you have a letter from my Moohmy to me?
npc.markwin.say_4: Uhm, well thank you, hornless being.
npc.markwin.say_5: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.markwin.say_6: I understand this as a peace-offering, human ... UNGH ... THIS IS AN OUTRAGE! THIS MEANS WAR!!!
npc.marlene.farewell_msg_1: Good bye and come again for another small talk! *waves*
npc.marlene.greet_msg_1: Ahhh, welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Say, have you already heard the latest news about the {seamonster}, {Aneus}, or the {rumours} in this area?
npc.marlene.multi_1: Well, I heard about evil beings living in a dungeon below us. So once I tried to find them and went down the hole far to the southwest. ...
npc.marlene.multi_10: He must have collected so much wisdom. *sigh* I wish I could also travel around the world. ...
npc.marlene.multi_11: I would try to visit as many cities and meet as many beings as possible. Who knows what strange races I will meet? ...
npc.marlene.multi_12: Maybe I can also find a lovely new dress for me. I have been looking for one for months now but never found a good one. Maybe... *keeps on babbling*
npc.marlene.multi_13: Only some days ago I was at the docks late in the night and was looking for my husband's ship when suddenly a known noise appeared near the docks. ...
npc.marlene.multi_14: I know this noise very well because it is the noise of a ship sailing very fast. I searched the horizon in hope to see my husbands ship. ...
npc.marlene.multi_15: But instead of a ship I saw a huge shape far away. It was like a big snake swimming in the sea. ...
npc.marlene.multi_16: I couldn't see it clearly because of the fog but I think I saw two lava-red eyes glowing in the nightly fog. ...
npc.marlene.multi_17: I ran into the house and hoped that my husband would arrive safely from fishing. And after one hour he finally arrived. ...
npc.marlene.multi_18: I told him about what I saw but he didn't believe me because he never saw anything like that in all the years before. But you believe me right? Go and convince yourself. ...
npc.marlene.multi_19: Just go to the docks at exactly midnight and be very quiet. Look at the horizon and maybe you will hear and see it, too!
npc.marlene.multi_2: I'm pretty curious, you know. *smiles* So I took the coat of invisibility from my husband and went down there. At first I only found some spiders, snakes, and wolves. ...
npc.marlene.multi_3: But after some time I found a ladder to a deeper level of the dungeon but I didn't dare to go down there because I heard many voices. ...
npc.marlene.multi_4: The voices were very strange and I ran back to my house because they were very loud and very angry. I hope they will never get the idea to attack the surface beings. ...
npc.marlene.multi_5: I heard they are almighty and have incredible powers! I already packed our stuff for an emergency escape. You never know. Maybe they plan to conquer the whole world. ...
npc.marlene.multi_6: I bet that they look very ugly. Most mighty monsters look very ugly. Hmm, you seem to be very strong. Maybe you can go deeper and explore the area. But be careful, please. ...
npc.marlene.multi_7: I heard that they can kill humans with only one hit! And that they have magic abilities twenty times stronger than the mightiest sorcerer in our world.
npc.marlene.multi_8: A very nice person. He has a great story to tell with big fights and much magic. Just ask him for his story. ...
npc.marlene.multi_9: I heard that he came from far, far away. He must have seen soooo many countries, cities, different races. ...
npc.marlene.stdmod_2: I'm Bruno's wife. Besides: Have you already heard the latest news about the seamonster, Aneus, or the rumours in this area?
npc.marlene.stdmod_3: Bruno is a wonderful husband. But he is seldom at home. *looks a little bit sad*
npc.marlene.stdmod_4: Ah, old Graubart. A very nice person. But he is strange. He always is busy when I want to talk to him. *lost in thoughts*
npc.marlene.stdmod_5: My pleasure, I always enjoy sharing interesting stories.
npc.marvin.greet_msg_1: Ah, you come just in time for the special voting about the most recent {funding} project. I guess you want to participate in it.
npc.marvin.multi_1: So far you earned x votes. Each single vote can be spent on a different topic or you're also able to cast all your votes on one voting. ...
npc.marvin.multi_2: Well in the topic b you have the possibility to vote for the funding of the {archives}, import of bug {milk} or street {repairs}.
npc.marvin.say_2: How many of your x votes do you want to cast?
npc.marvin.say_3: Did I get that right: You want to cast 1 of your votes on funding the {archives}?
npc.marvin.say_4: Thanks, you successfully cast your vote. Feel free to continue gathering votes by helping the city! Farewell.
npc.maryza.say_1: Welcome to the Jolly Axeman, |PLAYERNAME|. Have a good time and eat some food!
npc.maryza.say_2: The cookbook of the famous dwarven kitchen. You're lucky. I have a few copies on sale. Do you like one for 150 gold?
npc.maryza.say_3: I'm sorry but I sell only one copy to each customer. Otherwise they would have been sold out a long time ago.
npc.maryza.say_4: No gold, no sale, that's it.
npc.maryza.say_6: I have but a few copies, anyway.
npc.mazarius.greet_msg_1: Greetings, dear visitor. Please tell me what {brings} you here, to my humble adobe.
npc.mazarius.multi_1: With all their powers and vast magic knowledge they are still more pawns than anything else. Given their resources, ascension might seem within reach. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_10: Therefore he has to tap into other, probably even more sinister power sources. I can't tell what these sources are, but my scrying revealed that he has reached massive amounts of power. He has probably been infusing himself since years. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_11: By now he is apparently reaching the end circle of his ascension and could make his final move any day.
npc.mazarius.multi_12: Ascension is a fascinating topic that dates back to efforts and philosophies of some of the most ancient, and mostly extinct, races which fought in the godwars. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_13: Probably born out of desperation, they extensively researched ways to acquire godhood themselves. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_14: Some of them at least even met with moderate success. But the process is complicated at best, and may vary from race to race or even from one individual to another. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_15: The theories differ vastly and waxed and waned in popularity over the centuries if not aeons. Even today and in human society there are a number of obscure ascension cults. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_16: Some of them claim that humans are most suitable for ascension because they already own a bit of divinity through Banor's godly spark.
npc.mazarius.multi_17: It is a place, so to say, not completely of this world. It is separate of, yet strongly connected to, our own world. I would imagine it is quite limited in size and its laws of physics and magic should be roughly the same as ours. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_18: Being home to a host of demons for a while, I expect it to be a hostile and dangerous environment.
npc.mazarius.multi_19: For a long time, I thought the godbreaker to be some apocryphal myth. But apparently others had learned about the godbreaker in the aeons past and lusted for its power. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_2: The absence of any ascendant demon might prove that they are no true beings at all and literally damned to be stuck in their accursed forms.
npc.mazarius.multi_20: They had gathered hint after hint - until, ultimately, they were squashed by the Seven or their minions; which only made the leads that hinted at them all the more probable. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_21: What Zathroth hoped to accomplish with the creation of such a weapon can only be subject to speculation. Assumedly he already had slain Tibiasula, so the godbreaker might have been even more powerful, more absolute. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_22: However, it has to be assumed that in the end the sheer power of his creation scared Zathroth, who had to fear the weapon could one day be used against him. So he disassembled it. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_23: [EN] Knowing that they would never, ever allow one of their own to come in possession of all parts. Since then, the parts have been hidden in a {demi-plane} shared by the Seven.
npc.mazarius.multi_24: [EN] Well, I need 30 {demonic essences} to exchange for a passage so you can access.
npc.mazarius.multi_25: Well, I need 30 {demonic essences} to exchange for a passage so you can access.
npc.mazarius.multi_26: My studies indicate that without all doubt Ferumbras the fiendish is in the process of accumulating nearly godlike powers. We have to stop him.
npc.mazarius.multi_27: Therefore I need you to enter a hellish dimension and acquire the parts of a weapon, the {godbreaker}, powerful enough to stop him once and for all. Are you willing to help me in this dire mission?
npc.mazarius.multi_28: He obviously had taken an interest to the topic of ascension, and I came into possession of some of his early writings. ...You have to know I'm a scholar of some renown. In the course of my latest studies about ascension, I stumbled upon disturbing facts about the person of the all too well known Ferumbras, the fiendish. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_29: This, combined with investigation and divination, bit by bit led to the conclusion that all that Ferumbras has done in the past may be part of a cunning plan. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_3: The elves are like lost children. Their potential might be great, but they lack focus and dedication to truly improve. If their myths are true, some of the more early elves might have accomplished ascension. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_30: Considering his writings and the books he based them upon, it became clear that Ferumbras is planning his ascension to godlike status. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_31: All of his attacks and defeats only served one purpose: to become an integral part of the people's knowledge, fears and beliefs. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_32: He actually used this as an energy source, and combined it with some sources of power which might not all be of our own world. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_33: He uses this energy to increasingly empower himself and will eventually be prepared to take the final step to transform himself into a godlike being. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_34: With the knowledge what to look for, I acquired expensive but powerful artefacts to scry the world for the expected power signature - and indeed I made contact. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_35: To my horror I had to recognise that Ferumbras had already made significant progress, and his final bid for ascension is imminent! ...
npc.mazarius.multi_36: His power levels are already too high for there to be any hope of stopping him with conventional means. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_37: But not all is lost yet. During my studies about godhood, I learned that the dark Zathroth himself had created a weapon so powerful that it could actually slay a god. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_38: [EN] Ancient, forbidden texts hinted at a hellish place where the seven built deadly dungeons, and placed some of their most fearsome and terrible minions as guards, before they sealed the place off. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_39: [EN] I'm confident that I can prepare a matching ritual that will breach their protection and allow someone to enter their realm; but I'm in no way suited to handle the horrors to be encountered there. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_4: Yet even if hints strongly suggest those stories are true, the sheer inaction of those assumedly ascended beings is disturbing. Perhaps what those legendary elves achieved was something completely different.
npc.mazarius.multi_40: [EN] Therefore I have to ask you, if you are willing to retrieve the parts of the godbreaker, and face the threat of the ascending Ferumbras?
npc.mazarius.multi_41: Therefore I have to ask you, if you are willing to retrieve the parts of the godbreaker, and face the threat of the ascending Ferumbras?
npc.mazarius.multi_5: The dwarves are leftovers from a time long gone by. They have outlived their usefulness to the gods and seem to have come to terms with that. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_6: They are as unchanging as rock and no greatness awaits them any more. They missed their chance, if they ever had any.
npc.mazarius.multi_7: Although already powerful in his own right, it is obvious that his ultimate goal seems to be the ascension to godly powers. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_8: His whole existence seems to be centred on becoming a name that strikes fear into the heart of men and to become a persistent figure in the minds of humanity. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_9: This gives him a hold in reality and a kind of mould to fill with his power and conscience. It's also obvious that this kind of belief of the people alone won't be enough to empower him sufficiently. ...
npc.mazarius.say_1: Ah, you have heard about my search for experienced help. And indeed your reputation for solving certain {problems} has preceded you.
npc.mazarius.say_10: Thais has become a melting pot of some source. Yet whatever you melt, if the ingredients are corrupted, the outcome is always flawed.
npc.mazarius.say_11: Instead of banding together and starting to change something, they and Thais keep wasting resources in hostilities.
npc.mazarius.say_12: Edron has become as stagnant as the teachings in its academy. No new idea has been thought there for decades. The whole Edron is an example for what happens when humanity has become fat and lazy.
npc.mazarius.say_13: An almost laughable greed is persistent in that city. At least this makes knowledge and materials conveniently available to those who can match their prizes.
npc.mazarius.say_2: My problems are, so to say, dire news for the whole world. <sigh> I don't want to confuse you with overly complicated and lengthy stories, so do you want to hear the {long} version or the {short}?
npc.mazarius.say_3: Good!, but I need 30 {demonic essences} to exchange with the demonic messenger for a ticket for you to enter the Abodes of Torments.
npc.mazarius.say_4: Do you have 30 demonic essences to offer to the demonic messenger?
npc.mazarius.say_5: Excellent! This will empower possibilty to create a breach is enough to let you pass into that hellish hiding place. ...
npc.mazarius.say_6: You don't have the demonic essences, back here when you get it.
npc.mazarius.say_7: Given the internal power plays amongst the Seven, they are the ideal keepers for individual parts of an powerful artefact. Not one of them would allow his compatriots to hold such a power, and neither would trust the other.
npc.mazarius.say_8: Ah, a good man and a competent aid.
npc.mazarius.say_9: I like the quietness and the climate. And admittedly it helped my studies not to be constantly disturbed by petitioners.
npc.mehkesh.greet_msg_1: Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. If you are looking for potions, seek no further.
npc.mehkesh.voice_1: Potions brewed by the leading alchemists of the land!
npc.melchior.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.
npc.melchior.greet_msg_1: Welcome, {}! The lovely sound of your voice shines like a beam of light through my solitary darkness!
npc.melchior.greet_msg_2: Greetings, {}. I do not see your face, but I can read a thousand things in your voice!
npc.melchior.multi_1: The djinns have an ancient code of honour. This code includes a special concept of hospitality. Anybody who utters the word of greeting must not be attacked even if he is an enemy. Well, at least that is what the code says. ...
npc.melchior.multi_2: I have found out, though, that this does not work at all times. There is no point to say the word of greeting to an enraged djinn. ...
npc.melchior.multi_3: [EN] And keep in mind that you must choose sides in this conflict. You can only follow the Efreet or the Marid - once you have made your choice there is no way back. I know from experience that djinn do not tolerate double-crossing.
npc.melchior.multi_4: And keep in mind that you must choose sides in this conflict. You can only follow the Efreet or the Marid - once you have made your choice there is no way back. I know from experience that djinn do not tolerate double-crossing.
npc.melchior.walkaway_msg_1: Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.
npc.melfar.greet_msg_1: Just great, another disturbance. Just what I need.
npc.melfar.multi_1: So take this beaver bait. It will work best on dwarf trees. I'll mark the three trees on your map. Here .. here .. and here! So now mark those trees with the beaver bait. ...
npc.melfar.multi_2: If you're unlucky enough to meet one of the giant beavers, try to stay calm. Don't do any hectic moves, don't yell, don't draw any weapon, and if you should carry anything wooden on you, throw it away as far as you can.
npc.melfar.multi_3: Just great, another disturbance. Just what I need.
npc.melfar.multi_4: Ha! Men and wood you say? Well, I might be able to relocate some of our miners to the base. Acquiring wood is an entirely different matter though. ...
npc.melfar.multi_5: I can't spare any men for woodcutting right now but I have an unusual idea that might help. ...
npc.melfar.multi_6: As you might know, this area is troubled by giant beavers. Once a year, the miners decide to have some fun, so they lure the beavers and jump on them to have some sort of rodeo. ...
npc.melfar.multi_7: However, I happen to have some beaver bait left from the last year's competition. ...
npc.melfar.multi_8: If you place it on trees on some strategic locations, we could let the beavers do the work and later on, I'll send men to get the fallen trees. ...
npc.melfar.multi_9: Does this sound like something you can handle?
npc.melfar.say_1: Yes, I can hear them even from here. It has to be a legion of beavers! I'll send the men to get the wood as soon as their gnawing frenzy has settled! You can report to Ongulf that men and wood will be on their way!
npc.melfar.say_2: If you place the beaver bait on trees on some strategic locations, we could let the beavers do the work and later on, I'll send men to get the fallen trees.
npc.melfar.say_4: You dont have enough of gold coins.
npc.melfar.say_5: You want to buy a Flask with Beaver Bait for 100 gold coins?
npc.melian.greet_msg_1: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you?
npc.melian.stdmod_1: Do you seek a ride to {0} for {1}?
npc.melian.stdmod_10: Only licensed carpet pilots are allowed to fly those.
npc.melian.stdmod_11: There's so much green stuff down there that I'm not sure whether there are any, but yes, might be, might be.
npc.melian.stdmod_12: Well, dwarves and their steamboat technology are well and good, but nothing beats flying on a carpet.
npc.melian.stdmod_13: Well, dwarves and their steamboat technology are well and good, but nothing beats flying on a carpet.
npc.melian.stdmod_14: That's the name of that dwarven base as far as I know. Got a bit of a pessimistic ring to it if you ask me. Sounds to me like they're starving.
npc.melian.stdmod_15: I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_16: I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_17: I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_18: I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
