npc.nomad.stdmod_3: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.nomad.stdmod_4: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.nomad.stdmod_5: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.nomad.stdmod_6: Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.nomad.stdmod_7: Well, as I am quite in a {fix} currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
npc.nomad.stdmod_8: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.nomad.stdmod_9: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.noozer.greet_msg_1: Hm? Oh! Oh, yes a... visitor! Intruder? Benefactor...? Wha- what are you? If you want to pass through this cave, I may have to disappoint you. Or maybe not. It... depends. So, just passing through?
npc.noozer.multi_1: [EN] ...wait a second, I lost it. What was I going to say again? Ah yes - DANGEROUS! These. Caves. Are. Dangerous. No way you get out alive. Ever. Again. ...
npc.noozer.multi_2: [EN] Also you should not disturb those... people down there. Yeah. They... hm, wait, they - who are they again? Hey! Who are you? Are you talking to me?! Ah, ah... oh yes, I remember. ...
npc.noozer.multi_3: [EN] Wait - I am the guardian here, yes! The keeper of... something... or another, yes, I... guard this place. With my life. Don't I? Of course! ...
npc.noozer.multi_4: [EN] Is, er... this the moment where I should try to... stop you? Yes? No? Ah, you know what - you go down there, those guys are angry as dung anyway. Try your luck, return to me when you're done. If you still can. Or not.
npc.noozer.multi_5: Is, er... this the moment where I should try to... stop you? Yes? No? Ah, you know what - you go down there, those guys are angry as dung anyway. Try your luck, return to me when you're done. If you still can. Or not.
npc.noozer.say_1: I was stationed in this cave to... guard something. Right now I am not even sure what that was.
npc.noozer.say_2: Then don't waste my time. I'm doing some important... business... here. Actually... where am I? If I find out, I will be even more angry than I am now. Out of my sight.
npc.noozer.say_3: I was on a mission, too - I guess. It was all quite blurry back then. Maybe I'll leave this place after I recovered completely. I have to find out what happened to me.
npc.nor.say_1: Here, take the memory crystal and leave immediately.
npc.norf.greet_msg_1: Welcome, pilgrim. How may I {help} you? Are you in need of {healing}?
npc.norf.keyword_1: So receive the shielding of your spirit, pilgrim.
npc.norf.stdmod_1: Here in the whiteflower temple you may receive the blessing of spiritual shielding. But we must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you still interested?
npc.norf.stdmod_10: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.norf.stdmod_11: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.norf.stdmod_12: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.norf.stdmod_13: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.norf.stdmod_14: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.norf.stdmod_2: So receive the shielding of your spirit, pilgrim.
npc.norf.stdmod_3: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.norf.stdmod_4: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.norf.stdmod_5: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.norf.stdmod_6: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.norf.stdmod_7: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.norf.stdmod_8: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.norf.stdmod_9: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.norma.greet_msg_1: Welcome, welcome! Have a seat! If you like a drink or something to eat, just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.norma.say_1: Oh, you're back already? Did you bring a legion helmet, 100 chicken feathers and 50 honeycombs?
npc.norma.say_2: Pretty, isn't it? I made it myself, but I could teach you how to do that if you like. What do you say?
npc.norma.say_3: Okay, here we go, listen closely! I need a few things... a basic hat of course, maybe a legion helmet would do. Then about 100 chicken feathers... and 50 honeycombs as glue.That's it, come back to me once you gathered it!!
npc.norma.say_4: Aw, I guess you don't like feather hats. No big deal.
npc.norma.say_5: Sorry, but I can't see a legion helmet.
npc.norma.say_6: Sorry, but you don't enough chicken feathers.
npc.norma.say_7: Sorry, but you don't have enough honeycombs.
npc.norma.say_8: Great job! That must have taken a lot of work. Okay, you put it like this... then glue like this... here!
npc.norma.sendtrade_msg_1: Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
npc.norma.stdmod_1: Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
npc.norma.stdmod_10: I've never been better! I love my new {job}!
npc.norma.stdmod_11: No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need a weapon.
npc.norma.stdmod_12: As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.norma.stdmod_13: Ah, the monsters are far away. Let's party now!
npc.norma.stdmod_14: If you really want to talk about dungeons, visit Dallheim on the bridge near my bar.
npc.norma.stdmod_15: Ewww, I don't even want to think about the smell from the sewers right now!
npc.norma.stdmod_16: Oooh, I wouldn't dare gossiping about the king. He might have his spies here somewhere, you know.
npc.norma.stdmod_17: This is the world we live in, oh-oh-oh, and these are the hands we're given, oh-oh... oh, I'm sorry, I got carried away!
npc.norma.stdmod_18: As a premium adventurer you have many advantages, you should check them out!
npc.norma.stdmod_19: I serve the best drinks in town! What's it gonna be, lemonade? Wine? Milk? Beer? Just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.norma.stdmod_2: You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
npc.norma.stdmod_20: The temple is a good place to visit if you're in urgent need for healing.
npc.norma.stdmod_21: Well, the only help I could give you are some general {hints}. And a delicious {drink} along with it.
npc.norma.stdmod_22: No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
npc.norma.stdmod_23: No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
npc.norma.stdmod_24: Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
npc.norma.stdmod_25: <gets a dreamy look in her eyes>
npc.norma.stdmod_26: Al Dee treats his customers friendly, but he's badmouthing them once he had a few beers.
npc.norma.stdmod_27: I'm curious about her adventures. She really should come here more often!
npc.norma.stdmod_28: He got lucky when Willie and him played a game of dice about who gets to farm on which side of the river. Ever since, Willie holds a grudge against him.
npc.norma.stdmod_29: Hehe, that guy doesn't pretend to be anyone that he isn't. He is what he is - rude, but honest.
npc.norma.stdmod_30: Oh shush! It's kinda disgusting when he walks in here with animal blood on his hands!
npc.norma.stdmod_31: What Seymour doesn't teach you is how much fun you can have here!
npc.norma.stdmod_32: I invited her to my bar, but she refused. Oh well, it was worth a try!
npc.norma.stdmod_33: I think that poor guy never gets a break from work. At least he never comes here.
npc.norma.stdmod_34: That guy seriously needs some partying and a girlfriend.
npc.norma.stdmod_35: The oracle is on the top floor of the academy. You should go there once you are level 8 to leave this island.
npc.norma.stdmod_36: I think it's rather strange that he lives here with his granddaughter. No one's ever seen the parents of {Dixi}.
npc.norma.stdmod_37: I hate that name, it sounds so boring. Almost like 'normal'. I think I should change my name to something more exciting. Like... Marylin! Oh, what a glamorous sound!
npc.norma.stdmod_38: She told me that she dreams of leaving this island to go on a big adventure.
npc.norma.stdmod_4: Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
npc.norma.stdmod_5: Best place in town! Come to my bar!
npc.norma.stdmod_7: I used to be a merchant, but being a barkeeper is so much more fun. It's been my dream since I was a little girl.
npc.norma.stdmod_8: It's about |TIME|. Time just flies, doesn't it?
npc.norma.stdmod_9: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.norma.voice_1: Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
npc.norma.voice_2: You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
npc.norma.voice_4: Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
npc.norma.voice_5: Best place in town! Come to my bar!
npc.norma.walkaway_msg_1: Hey, where are you going? We've just started!
npc.nurik.greet_msg_1: It's .. It's YOU! At last!! So what's this special proposal you would like to make, my friend?
npc.nurik.multi_1: Excellent! Here is the painting you requested. It's quite precious to my father, but imagine his joy when I tell him about my clever deal! ...
npc.nurik.multi_2: Now leave me alone please. I have to prepare for my departure. Now my family will not call me a squandering fool anymore!
npc.nurik.multi_3: That's just incredible! I've dreamed about acquiring the dwarven bridge since I was a child! Now my dream will finally become true. ...
npc.nurik.multi_4: And you are sure you want to sell it? I mean really, really sure?
npc.nurik.say_1: Excuse me, but I'm waiting for someone important!
npc.nurik.say_2: Wait a minute! Do I get that right? You're the owner of the dwarven bridge and you are willing to sell it to me??
npc.nurik.say_3: How splendid! Do you have the necessary documents with you?
npc.nurik.say_4: Oh my, oh my. I'm so excited! So let's seal this deal as fast as possible so I can visit my very own dwarven bridge. Are you ready for the transaction?
npc.nydala.sendtrade_msg_1: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
npc.nydala.stdmod_1: Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.
npc.nydala.stdmod_2: My name is Nydala. I run this store.
npc.nydala.stdmod_3: It is |TIME|. Do you need a clock for your house?
npc.obi.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, I hope you were satisfied with our service.
npc.obi.greet_msg_1: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}!
npc.obi.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.obi.stdmod_1: Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons!
npc.obi.stdmod_10: It's about |TIME|. Yes, |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches for sale.
npc.obi.stdmod_11: My name is Obi, just Obi, the honest merchant. If you like to {trade}, just ask.
npc.obi.stdmod_12: I'm a merchant and the local {weapon} smith. If you like to see my quality wares or sell weapons to me, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.obi.stdmod_13: As an adventurer you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.obi.stdmod_14: If I were you, I'd invest my money in quality steel rather than putting it in a so-called safe bank account!
npc.obi.stdmod_15: Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.obi.stdmod_16: Ah, Rookgaard. Home sweet home, that's what it became for me, but I will always miss {Thais} and {Sam}.
npc.obi.stdmod_17: Oh, Thais, I'll be back. One day, I'll be back.
npc.obi.stdmod_18: My good old cousin Sam. Oh, how I miss him.
npc.obi.stdmod_19: I think good practice is better than reading a boring book. Of course, you will need proper {equipment} to be able to get practice!
npc.obi.stdmod_20: told them to let me sell food, but no! Sorry, you have to ask {Willie} or {Billy} on the farms west of here.
npc.obi.stdmod_21: Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.obi.stdmod_22: There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. One is right outside this shop and to the left. For more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the {guards}.
npc.obi.stdmod_23: The bridge guard {Dallheim} is north of here, just follow the street, you can't miss it.
npc.obi.stdmod_24: Sadly, not many merchants are as honest as I am.
npc.obi.stdmod_25: I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Lily}.
npc.obi.stdmod_26: There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Nature's for free.
npc.obi.stdmod_27: I'm fine. It's a little hot near the crucible, but I enjoy the sound of forging {weapons}.
npc.obi.stdmod_28: Just ask me for a {trade} to see which things I buy from you.
npc.obi.stdmod_29: Oh, just upstairs. My granddaughter {Dixi} is in charge of selling armors and shields.
npc.obi.stdmod_3: Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
npc.obi.stdmod_30: Yes, I'm selling weapons. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers and the things I buy from you.
npc.obi.stdmod_31: Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.obi.stdmod_32: I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.obi.stdmod_33: I sell {weapons} of all kinds. Just ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my offers.
npc.obi.stdmod_34: I don't know how anyone could give up the flourishing business she led. She should have listened to me and find someone who continues that business for her.
npc.obi.stdmod_35: I told him there was no danger, but he wouldn't listen to me, no one listens to me.
npc.obi.stdmod_36: I suggested him opening a tourist guide company with me, Obi's and Santiago's, but he didn't approve. I really don't understand why.
npc.obi.stdmod_37: An old woman shouldn't be treated like that, no way, that's bad.
npc.obi.stdmod_38: Oh, this guy is so greedy, so greedy. Ripping off poor adventurers like you!
npc.obi.stdmod_39: She is beautiful, very, very beautiful. I hope I can impress her somehow.
npc.obi.stdmod_4: Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!
npc.obi.stdmod_41: This guy doesn't understand that he should entrust me with the food business, too. He really should do. Then he had time for his farm.
npc.obi.stdmod_42: He shouldn't heal people for free, no he shouldn't. That would be a great source of income for the village that could be invested in enhancing the smithy.
npc.obi.stdmod_43: Oh, what an endearing little girl, and she's working so hard to help me, even without receiving payment. Such a sweet little girl!
npc.obi.stdmod_44: I don't like him, actually I dislike him deeply. He is so greedy that he doesn't want to share his profit he gains from health potions.
npc.obi.stdmod_45: She ruins the market with her offers! This is bad for us honest merchants, really bad.
npc.obi.stdmod_46: I knew it! I knew she would try to get the monopoly on potions in this village! But no one has listened to me!
npc.obi.stdmod_47: The oracle, ah, such a weird being! It will lead you off this island once you are level 8, yes it will, mark my words.
npc.obi.stdmod_5: Well, how can I help you? Do you need some general {hints}? Or, if you're interested in a {trade}, just ask.
npc.obi.stdmod_6: What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
npc.obi.stdmod_8: Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
npc.obi.stdmod_9: The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
npc.obi.voice_1: Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons!
npc.obi.voice_3: Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
npc.obi.voice_4: Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!
npc.oblivion.greet_msg_1: A shadow preceded you. You wish?
npc.oblivion.multi_1: Ah, the Lady of Darkstone. You have done well to remember her name. ...
npc.oblivion.multi_2: Now, the shadows say the thing you seek lies next to Akab, the Quarrelsome. ...
npc.oblivion.multi_3: No coal is burned in his honour. Find his resting place and dig near it. Now go.
npc.oblivion.multi_4: Then into the vampire crypts, deep down, you must go. ...
npc.oblivion.multi_5: There... three graves where the shadows swirl, unseen. The first one: name the colour of the silent gong. Then ...
npc.oblivion.multi_6: The second: the name that is silent now in the halls of Darkstone ...
npc.oblivion.multi_7: The third: the lost beauty of Dunesea. It must be remembered, the shadows command it. Go now.
npc.oblivion.say_1: Lost. Hidden. The keys are shadow names. Find them, they will talk to me and reveal what is hidden. Will you go on that quest?
npc.oblivion.say_2: Yes. Have you gone there and found what you sought?
npc.oblivion.say_3: Tell me. Begin with the colour.
npc.oblivion.say_4: Yes. The shadows say this is true. The beauty of House Dunesea, name it.
npc.oblivion.say_5: The floating gardens. Too beautiful to lie asleep in the memory of men. Yes. The name that is no more in Darkstone?
npc.ocelus.multi_1: Oh yes, I noticed that lovely mermaid. From afar of course. I would not dare to step into the eyes of such a lovely creature. ...
npc.ocelus.multi_2: ... I guess I am quite shy. Oh my, if I were not blue, I would turn red now. If there would be someone to arrange a {date} with her.
npc.ocelus.say_2: Oh my. Its not easy to impress a mermaid I guess. Please get me a {love poem}. I think elves are the greatest poets so their city seems like a good place to look for one.
npc.ocelus.say_3: Will you ask the mermaid Marina if she would date me?
npc.ocelus.say_4: Thank you. How ironic, a human granting a djinn a wish.
npc.ocelus.say_5: Excellent. Here, with this little spell I enable you to recite the poem like a true elven poet. Now go and ask her for a date again.
npc.ocelus.say_6: Did you get a love poem from Ab'Dendriel?
npc.old_adall.stdmod_1: Do you seek a passage to the {0} end for {1}?
npc.old_adall.stdmod_3: I can bring you either to the east end of Port Hope or to the west end of the town, where would you like to go?
npc.oldrak.goshnar: The greatest necromant who ever cursed our land with the steps of his feet. He was defeated by the nightmare knights.
npc.oldrak.greet_msg_1: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Only rarely I can welcome {visitors} these days.
npc.oldrak.job: I guard this humble temple as a monument for the order of the {nightmare knights}.
npc.oldrak.monster: These plains are not safe for ordinary travellers. It will take heroes to survive here.
npc.oldrak.multi_1: You chopped down the demon oak?!? Unbelievable!! Let's hope it doesn't come back. As long as evil is still existent in the soil of the plains, it won't be over. Still, the demons suffered a setback, that's for sure. ...
npc.oldrak.multi_2: For your brave action, I tell you a secret which has been kept for many many years. There is an old house south of the location where you found the demon oak. There should be a grave with the name 'Yesim Adeit' somewhere close by. ...
npc.oldrak.multi_3: It belongs to a Daramian nobleman named 'Teme Saiyid'. I knew him well and he told me -almost augured- that someone will come who is worthy to obtain his treasure. I'm sure this 'someone' is you. Good luck in finding it!
npc.oldrak.name: My name is Oldrak.
npc.oldrak.say_1: How do you know? Did you go into the infested area?
npc.oldrak.say_10: What a pity! Let me know when you managed to get in there. Maybe I can help you when we know what we are dealing with.
npc.oldrak.say_12: Ah, the curse of the Plains of Havoc, the hidden beast, the unbeatable foe. I've been living here for years and I'm sure this is only a myth.
npc.oldrak.say_13: There are many tales about the fearsome Hugo. It's said it's an abnormality, accidentally created by Yenny the Gentle. It's half demon, half something else and people say it's still alive after all these years.
npc.oldrak.say_14: Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of the most powerful wielders of magic in ancient times. She was known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
npc.oldrak.say_15: Would you like to buy a The Holy Tible for 1000 gold?
npc.oldrak.say_16: You need to complete the quest for the book first before you can buy The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.say_17: Here is your The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.say_18: You do not have enough money.
npc.oldrak.say_2: You better don't return here until you've defeated the Demon Oak.
npc.oldrak.say_3: A demon oak?!? <mumbles some blessings> May the gods be on our side. You'll need a {hallowed axe} to harm that tree. Bring me a simple {axe} and I'll prepare it for you.
npc.oldrak.say_4: I don't believe a word of it! How rude to lie to a monk!
npc.oldrak.say_5: Ahh, you've got an axe. Very good. I can make a hallowed axe out of it. It will cost you... er... a donation of 1,000 gold. Alright?
npc.oldrak.say_6: You have to first talk about {demon oak} or the {mission} before we continue.
npc.oldrak.say_7: Let's see....<mumbles a prayer>....here we go. The blessing on this axe will be absorbed by all the demonic energy around here. I presume it will not last very long, so better hurry. Actually, I can refresh the blessing as often as you like.
npc.oldrak.say_8: There is no axe with you.
npc.oldrak.say_9: There is not enough of money with you.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_1: This ancient order was created by a circle of wise humans who were called 'The {Dreamers}'. The order became {extinct} a long time ago.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_10: That's where we are. The world of Tibia.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_11: They created Tibia and all life on it ... and unlife, too.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_14: A weapon of myth and legend. It was lost in ancient times ... perhaps lost forever.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_15: Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of most powerfull magicwielders in ancient times and known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_16: I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_17: I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_18: I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_19: I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_2: Many perished in their battles against evil, some went mad, not able to stand their nightmares any longer. Others were seduced by the darkness.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_20: I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_3: They learned the ancient art of {dreamwalking} from some elves they befriended.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_4: While the dreamwalkers of the elves experienenced the brightest dreams of pleasure, the humans strangely had dreams of {dark omen}.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_5: They dreamed of doom, destruction, talked to dead, tormented souls, and gained unwanted insight into the {schemes of darkness}.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_6: They figured out how to interpret their dark dreams and so could foresee the plans of the dark gods and their minions.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_7: Using this knowledge they formed an order to thwart these plans, and because they battled their nightmares as brave as knights, they named their order accordingly.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_8: It is rumoured to open the entrance to the pits of inferno, also called the nightmare pits. Even if I knew about this secret I wouldn't tell you.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_9: Before the battles raged across them, they were called the fair plains.
npc.oldrak.walkaway_msg_1: Take care, it's dangerous out there.
npc.oliver.say_1: Nobody knows the trouble I've seen .. <tells a quite detailed report>.
npc.oliver.say_2: You can {pass} either to the {Factory Quarter} or {Sunken Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.olrik.farewell_msg_1: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.olrik.greet_msg_1: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.

npc.one_eyed_joe.greet_msg_1: Well done! But know this: The cursed crystal seems to regenerate over time. It could be necessary to come back and repeat whatever you have done down there.
npc.one_eyed_joe.greet_msg_2: Hello there. I'm sorry, I hardly noticed you. I'm a bit nervous. The spooky {sounds} down there, you know
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_1: [EN] But there are few volunteers. Often the crystal gatherers disappear and are never seen again. Other poor fellows then meet their former shipmates in the form of ghosts or skeletons. It's a {cursed} area, something evil is down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_10: At first glance it seems to be a beautiful - and precious - surrounding. But in truth, deep down in these caverns exists an old evil. Want to hear more?
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_2: But there are few volunteers. Often the crystal gatherers disappear and are never seen again. Other poor fellows then meet their former shipmates in the form of ghosts or skeletons. It's a {cursed} area, something evil is down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_3: As for myself I haven't been down there. But I heard some disturbing rumours. In these caves are wonderful crystal formations. Some more poetically inclined fellows call them the crystal gardens. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_4: At first glance it seems to be a beautiful - and precious - surrounding. But in truth, deep down in these caverns exists an old evil. Want to hear more?
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_5: In my humble opinion a pirate should win a fortune by boarding ships not by crawling through caves and tunnels. But who am I to bring into question the captain's decision. All I know is that they sell the crystals at a high price. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_6: A certain amount of the crystals is ground to crystal dust with a special kind of mill. Don't ask me why. Some kind of magical component perhaps that they sell to mages and sorcerers.
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_7: The evil I mentioned is a strange crystal, imbued with some kind of unholy energy. It is very hard to destroy, no weapon is able to shatter the thing. Maybe a jarring, very loud sound could destroy it. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_8: I heard of creatures, that are able to utter ear-splitting sounds. Don't remember the name, though. Would you go down there and try to destroy the crystal?
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_9: As for myself I haven't been down there. But I heard some disturbing rumours. In these caves are wonderful crystal formations. Some more poetically inclined fellows call them the crystal gardens. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_1: Hmm. No, I don't think so. I still feel this strange prickling in my toes.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_3: Protect your ears? Hmm ... Wasn't there some fabulous seafarer who used wax or something to plug his ears? There was a story about horrible bird-women or something ...? No, sounds like hogwash, doesn't it.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_4: Great! Good luck and be careful down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_5: I'm a pirate. Normally I'm sailing the seas, boarding other ships and gathering treasures. But at the moment my captain graciously assigned me to watch this {cursed} entrance.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_6: I'm One-Eyed Joe. From Josephina, got that? And I regard this eye patch as a personal feature of beauty!
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_7: Good bye adventurer. It was nice to talk with you.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_8: Ah, the brave adventurer who sought to destroy the evil crystal down there. Have you been successful?
npc.ongulf.greet_msg_1: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. You've come at a good time for our {project}.
npc.ongulf.multi_1: Oh, my! That sounds like a real mess. For now this dragon empire seems otherwise engaged, but we will be on guard thanks to you my friend. We will continue to fortify the base. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_10: If the orcs are right, they are somewhere in or behind those mountains in the north. I doubt you can reason with them in any way, but you'll have to try for the sake of Farmine.
npc.ongulf.multi_11: Our new friends, those primitive humans sent us a warning. According to them, the 'green men' of the plains plan an attack on the mountains. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_12: Considering their expected number, there is no chance for us to beat them off. We might be able to hold our ground for a while, but without access to the surface and under constant attacks, we might have to abandon the base. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_13: Now, I'm aware that you cannot stop an entire army by yourself, but desperate situations call for desperate measures. I ask you to find the leaders of the orcs and - well do something. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_14: Scare them, bribe them, give them another target or whatever. As futile as it may sound: Try to talk to their leaders in some way and make them stop their attack plans. This is our only hope.
npc.ongulf.multi_15: Things are getting more and more complicated. You need to convince our friends that some intervention for their part is needed. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_16: We've come a long way with our own resources, but now our resources are short and we need the others to step in. I want you to negotiate some more support from our partners. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_17: You'll need all your diplomacy and influence. If you blow the negotiations, look for a guy called Black Bert in Thais. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_18: He has access to all kind of odd items, and he might have just the right bribe to convince someone to continue negotiations. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_19: It will not be as easy as it might sound. So watch your words and your manners and keep in mind whom you are talking to. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_2: This leaves not much to do for you down here. I recommend you continue to explore this strange new land. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_20: Different strategies might be necessary for different people. You may try to FLATTER, THREATEN, IMPRESS, BLUFF, PLEA or to REASON with them. You probably need some luck as well. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_21: And now listen: We need more workers for the mines. The technomancers told us that a guy named Telas, who lives in Edron, copied the worker golem technology from Yalahar. Convince him to send us some of these golems. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_22: Further, we have more ore and end products than we can use right now. So we need someone to buy all the surplus. Convince Leeland Slim in Venore that the local traders step in as resellers. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_23: Another issue at hand is our lack of drilling worms. That should not be a big problem though. Just talk to the worm tamer in Kazordoon. If he does not get mad about you, there should be no problem to get his support. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_24: Also, now that our monetary resources are used up and not much cash is coming in, we need additional help to finance this venture. Thais has promised money in advance, but we haven't seen any of this support, yet. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_25: Convince the Thaian king to send us the promised money right now. ...

npc.ongulf.say_59: Now, I'm aware that you cannot stop an entire army by yourself, but desperate situations call for desperate measures. I ask you to find the leaders of the orcs and - well do something. ...

Something spoke to me, telling me I had to be its voice; a voice of the Oracle here for the sake of the adventurers that would come to defend {World} against evil and need to {choose} their destiny.
npc.oressa.stdmod_9: If you are hurt my child, I will {heal} your wounds.
npc.oressa.vocation_default_1: A vocation is your profession and destiny, determining your skills and way of fighting. There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each one has its unique special abilities. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_2: When you leave the outpost through one of the four gates upstairs, you will be equipped with training gear of a specific vocation in order to defend yourself against the monsters outside. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_3: You can try them out as often as you wish to. When you have gained enough experience to reach level 8, you are ready to choose the definite vocation that is to become your destiny. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_4: Think carefully, as you can't change your vocation later on! You will have to choose your vocation in order to leave Dawnport for the main continent through one of these {doors} behind me. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_5: Talk to me again when you are ready to choose your vocation, and I will set you on your way.
npc.oressa.voice_1:
[EN] You can't take it all with you - sell your Dawnport things before \z
		you receive the gear of your definite vocation!
npc.oressa.voice_2: Leave all Dawnport things behind you and choose your destiny!
npc.oressa.voice_3: Come to me if you need healing!
npc.oressa.voice_4: Choose your vocation and explore the mainland!
npc.oressa.voice_5: Talk to me to choose your definite vocation! Become a knight, paladin, druid or sorcerer!
npc.oressa.voice_6: World needs brave adventurers like you. Choose your vocation and sail to the mainland!
npc.oressa.voice_7: Poisoned? Bleeding? Wounded? I can help!
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_1: In this category I have '{Bruise Bane}', '{Cure Bleeding}', '{Wound Cleansing}', '{Cure Poison}', '{Intense Wound Cleansing}', '{Recovery}' and '{Intense Recovery}'.
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_2: In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Haste}', '{Charge}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_3: I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_4: In this category I have '{Whirlwind Throw}', '{Groundshaker}', '{Berserk}' and '{Fierce Berserk}' as well as ... '{Brutal Strike}', '{Front Sweep}', '{Inflict Wound}' and '{Annihilation}'.
npc.orockle.say_1: You can help in the fight against the hive. There are several missions available to destabilise the hive. Just ask for them if you want to learn more. After completing many missions you might be worthy to get a reward.
npc.orockle.say_2: You could try to blind the hive, you might disrupt its digestion, you could gather acid or you can disable the swarm pores. ...
npc.orockle.say_3: So be it. Now you are a member of the inquisition. You might ask me for a mission to raise in my esteem.
npc.ortheus.greet_msg_1: What's your business here with the {magicians}, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.ortheus.say_1: A cookie? Well... I have to admit I haven't had one for ages. Can I have it?
npc.ortheus.say_2: It'd be better for you to leave now.
npc.ortheus.say_3: Well thanks, it looks tasty, I'll just take a bi - COUGH! Are you trying to poison me?? Get out of here before I forget myself!
npc.ortheus.say_4: Wow. These polite young adventurers nowadays. Thank you.
npc.ortheus.say_5: Hmmm, you don't have tea with you.
npc.ortheus.say_6: Have you actually brought me a mug of tea??
npc.ortheus.stdmod_1: I can't imagine a better place to live.

npc.ortheus.stdmod_11: He sometimes delivers fruit and vegetables to this quarter.

npc.ortheus.stdmod_13: I can't imagine a better place to live
npc.ortheus.stdmod_15: I don't have anything that I could give you as a reward. Guess you aren't so selfless after all, huh?
npc.ortheus.stdmod_16: They try to protect the city and do a decent job. Well - no, a poor job, I mean a poor job.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_17: You can bring me a mug of tea if you want to.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_2: Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities.

npc.ortheus.stdmod_5: I don't know what you're talking about.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_6: Yes, it's a bit messy down there. Sorry.
npc.oswald.say_33: What? So why in the world should I give you an invitation? It's not as if you were someone important, are you?
npc.oswald.say_34: Well, rich and generous people are always welcome in the palace.If you donate 1000 gold to a fund I oversee, I'll give you an invitation, ok?
npc.oswald.say_37: Not that I am bribeable but I doubt that you own 1000 gold pieces. Or do you?
npc.oswald.stdmod_1: I think the gods are too busy to care about us mortals, hmm... that makes me feel godlike, too.
npc.oswald.stdmod_10: It is nearly tea time, so please hurry!
npc.oswald.stdmod_11: It's rumoured that Sam does not forge all weapons himself, but buys them from his cousin, who is married to a cyclops.
npc.oswald.stdmod_12: If you want to see dungeons just don't pay your taxes.
npc.oswald.stdmod_13: It's beyond all doubt that certain sinister elements in our city have certain knowledge about this myth.
npc.oswald.stdmod_14: You are not the first one to ask about that. Am I the only one that preferes wine to such disgusting stuff?
npc.oswald.stdmod_15: What do you expect from ex-soldiers? He is nuts! Hacked on the head far too often.
npc.oswald.stdmod_16: Isn't he the artist formerly known as the prince?
npc.oswald.stdmod_17: I never found any rumour concerning him, isn't that odd?
npc.oswald.stdmod_18: They say she killed over a dozen husbands already.
npc.oswald.stdmod_19: This man lives in the darkness like a rat and is also as handsome as one of them. He surely is up to no good and often consorts with sinister strangers.
npc.oswald.stdmod_2: I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent {Durin}!
npc.oswald.stdmod_20: Just last week a one eyed man, who had a room at Frodo's, met him in the middle of the night.
npc.oswald.stdmod_21: He sells his scrolls far too expensive.
npc.oswald.stdmod_22: I was told he lost a body part or two in duels... if you know what I mean.
npc.oswald.stdmod_23: He is rumoured to summon kinky demons to... well you know.
npc.oswald.stdmod_24: You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!
npc.oswald.stdmod_26: I heard he was a ladies' man in younger days. In our days he is rumoured to wear women clothes now and then.
npc.oswald.stdmod_27: A simple shopkeeper with minor intelligence.
npc.oswald.stdmod_28: They say he isn't truly dead. He was... or is a necromant after all.
npc.oswald.stdmod_29: Some say he is Ferumbras in disguise.
npc.oswald.stdmod_3: I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent {Durin}!
npc.oswald.stdmod_30: What a shame. He claimed to be the king of thiefs and was caught stealing some fruit.
npc.oswald.stdmod_31: Just between you and me, he can be quite a tyrant.
npc.oswald.stdmod_4: I have a job of great responsibility, mostly I keep annoying persons away from my boss.
npc.oswald.stdmod_5: You better don't ask, you wouldn't like the answer.
npc.oswald.stdmod_6: Ah, yes, yes, hail to King {Tibianus}! Long live the king and so on...
npc.oswald.stdmod_7: I overheard a conversation of officials, that magic will be forbidden soon.
npc.oswald.stdmod_8: My name is Oswald, but let's proceed, I am a very busy man.
npc.oswald.stdmod_9: Hey, I am not a shopkeeper, I am an important man!
npc.oswald.walkaway_msg_1: Good bye, and don't come back too soon.

npc.padreia.multi_1: I knew I could count on you. Take this highly intensified vermin poison. In my vision, I saw some kind of 'pool' where these slimes came from. ...
npc.padreia.multi_2: Pour the poison in the water to stop the demise of Carlin. Tell me about your mission after you fulfilled your task.
npc.padreia.multi_4: , thank god you came to me. Last night, I had a vision about an upcoming plague here in Carlin. ...
npc.padreia.say_1: Do you want to buy a bottle of cough syrup for 50 gold?
npc.padreia.say_10: They thought they had to bring Crunor to the people, if the people had not found Crunor on their own. To achieve this, they founded the inn called Crunor's Cottage, south of Mt. Sternum.
npc.padreia.say_11: Do you want to buy a bottle of cough syrup for 50 gold?
npc.padreia.say_12: Oh {}, thank god you came to me. Last night, I had a vision about an upcoming plague here in Carlin. ...
npc.padreia.say_13: It will originate from slimes that will swarm out of the sewers and infect every citizen with a deadly disease. Are you willing to help me save Carlin?
npc.padreia.say_14: You MUST find that slime pool immediately or life here in Carlin will not be the same anymore.
npc.padreia.say_15: You did it! Even if only few of the Carliners will ever know about that, you saved all of their lives. Here, take this as a reward. Farewell!
npc.padreia.say_16: Maybe the guards have something to do for you or know someone who could need some help.

npc.palimuth.multi_1: You'll find our seven guards at the gates of each quarter. Just ask them for their report and they will tell you all you need to know.
npc.palimuth.multi_10: I'm afraid we have not seen the last chapter of Yalahar's drama. But anyhow, I wish to thank you for putting your life at stake for our cause. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_11: I allow you to enter the Yalaharian treasure room. I'm sure that you can put what you find inside to better use than them. Choose one chest, but think before takingone! ...
npc.palimuth.multi_12: Also, take this Yalaharian outfit. Depending on which side you chose previously, you can also acquire one specific addon. Thank you again for your help.
npc.palimuth.multi_13: I cannot tell you how we acquired this information, but we have heard that a circle of Yalahari is planning some kind of ritual. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_14: They plan to create a portal for some powerful demons and to unleash them in the city to 'purge' it once and for all. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_15: I doubt those poor fools will be able to control such entities. I can't figure out how they came up with such an insane idea, but they have to be stopped. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_16: The entrance to their inner sanctum has been opened for you. Please hurry and stop them before it's too late. Be prepared for a HARD battle! Better gather some friends to assist you.
npc.palimuth.multi_17: Listen, I know you have worked for Azerus and his friends, but it is not too late to change your mind! I beg you to rethink your loyalties. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_18: The fate of the whole city might depend on your decision! Think about your options carefully.
npc.palimuth.multi_19: The constant unrest in the city is to a great extent caused by the lack of food. Weapons will only serve to suppress the poor. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_2: I must warn you, the quarters are in a horrible state. I strongly advise you to stay on the main roads whenever possible while you get those reports. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_20: The factory you were sent to was once used for the production of food. Somewhere in the factory you might find an old pattern crystal for the production of food. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_21: If you use it on the controls instead of the weapon pattern, you will ensure that our people are supplied with the desperately needed food. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_22: The quara are indeed a threat. Yet, they are numerous and reproduce quickly. Slaying some of them will only enrage them even more. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_23: The quara have been there for many generations. They have never threatened anyone who stayed out of their watery realm. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_24: It would be much more useful to find out what the quara are so upset about. Better avoid slaying their leaders as this will only further the animosities.
npc.palimuth.multi_25: I thank you also in the name of these poor lost souls. I will send the charm to a priest who is able to release them. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_26: Tell the Yalahari that the charm was destroyed by the energy it contained.
npc.palimuth.multi_27: What a sick idea to misuse tortured souls to power some device! Though, this charm might be useful to free these poor souls. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_28: Please capture the souls as you have been instructed and then bring the charm to me. I will see to it that the souls are freed to go to the afterlife in peace.
npc.palimuth.multi_29: Warbeasts? Is this true? People are already starving. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_3: I'm pleased to hear that. Rarely we meet outsiders that care about our problems. Most people come here looking for wealth and luxury. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_30: How can we afford to feed an army of hungry beasts? They will not only strengthen the power of the Yalahari over the citizens, they also mean starvation and deathfor the poor. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_31: Instead of breeding warbeasts, this druid should breed cattle to feed our people. Please I beg you, convince him to do that!
npc.palimuth.multi_32: You did quite well in gaining a new friend who will work together with us. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_33: I'm sure he'll still try to gain some profit but that's still better than his former one-man rule during which he dictated his own laws.
npc.palimuth.multi_34: Mr. West is a little paranoid. That's the reason for his immense private army of bodyguards. He could surely be helpful, especially as he rules over the former trade quarter. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_35: If you were able to reach him without killing his henchmen, you could probably convince him that you mean no harm to him. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_36: That would certainly cement our relationship without any needless bloodshed. Perhaps you could use the way through the sewers to avoid his men. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_37: Mr. West is not a bad man. We should be able to work out some plans to reconstruct the city's safety as soon as he overcomes his paranoia towards us.
npc.palimuth.multi_38: This quarter has been sealed off years ago. To send someone there poses a high risk to spread the plague. I assume these research notes you've mentioned must be very important. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_39: After all those years it is more than strange that someone shows interest in these notes now. Considering what has happened to the alchemists, it is rather unlikely that they contain harmless information. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_4: However, I have to tell you that our ranking system is quite rigid. So, I'm not allowed to entrust you with important missions as long as you haven't proven yourself as reliable. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_40: I fear these notes will be used to turn the plague into some kind of weapon. Someone with this plague at his disposal could subdue the whole city by blackmailing. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_41: I beg you to destroy these notes. Just put them into some burning oven to get rid of them and report that you did not find the notes.
npc.palimuth.multi_42: Now you know as much as we do about the things happening in Yalahar. It's up to you what you do with this information. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_43: Now leave and talk to my superior Azerus in the city centre to get your next mission. I urge you, though, to talk to me whenever he sends you on a new mission. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_44: I think it is important that you hear my opinion about them. Now hurry. I suppose Azerus is already waiting.
npc.palimuth.multi_45: I did my best to impress my superiors with your accomplishments and it seems that it worked quite well. They want you for their own missions now. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_46: Missions that are more important than the ones you've fulfilled for me. However, before you leave, there are still some things I need to tell you. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_47: Listen, I can't explain you everything in detail right now and here. You never know who might be eavesdropping. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_48: I left some notes in the small room there. Get them and read them. Talk to me again when you've read the notes.
npc.palimuth.multi_49: We are still present at each quarter's city wall, even though we can do little to stop the chaos from spreading. Still, our garrisons are necessary to maintain some sort of order in the city. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_5: If you are willing to work for the city of Yalahar, you can ask me for a {mission} any time, be it night or day.
npc.palimuth.multi_50: My superiors ask for a first hand report about the current situation in the single city quarters. I need someone to travel to our garrisons to get the reports from the guards. Are you willing to do that?
npc.palimuth.multi_51: I hope your first mission will not scare you off. Even though, we cut off our sewer system from other parts of the city to prevent the worst, it still has deteriorated in the last decades. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_52: Certain parts of the controls are rusty and the drains are stuffed with garbage. Get yourself a crowbar, loosen the controls and clean the pipes from the garbage. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_53: We were able to locate the 4 worst spots in the sewers. I will mark them for you on your map so you have no trouble finding them. Report to me when you have finished your {mission}. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_54: You probably heard that we have numerous problems in different quarters of our city. Our forces are limited, so we really could need some help from outsiders. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_55: Would you like to assist us in re-establishing order in our city?
npc.palimuth.multi_6: So the Yalahari that opposed us are dead or fled from the city. This should bring us more stability and perhaps a true chance to rebuild the city. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_7: Still, I wonder from where they gained some of the Yalahari secrets. Did they find some source of knowledge? ...
npc.palimuth.multi_8: And if so, is this source still around so that we can use it for the benefit of our city? What really troubles me is that none of those false Yalahari had the personality of agreat leader. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_9: Quite the opposite, they were opportunistic and not exactly bold. Perhaps they were led by some greater power which stayed behind the scenes. ...
npc.palimuth.say_1: I'm an Augur of the city of Yalahar. My special duty consists of coordinating the efforts to keep the city and its services running.
npc.palimuth.say_10: Thank you very much. You have no idea how hard it was to find someone volunteering for that job. If you feel ready for further {missions}, just tell me.
npc.palimuth.say_11: Excellent! My superiors will be pleased to get these reports. I will for sure emphasise your efforts in this mission. Please come back soon to see if there are any more {missions} available for you.
npc.palimuth.say_13: You have no idea how much I hoped to hear that, my friend! But I have an urgent mission for you!
npc.palimuth.say_14: Great! Here, take this yalaharian addon in a return.
npc.palimuth.say_2: Did you bring me the vampiric crest?
npc.palimuth.say_3: So are you done with your work?
npc.palimuth.say_4: Did you get all the reports my superiors asked for?
npc.palimuth.say_5: These are great news indeed. The people of Yalahar will be grateful. The Yalahari probably not, so take care of yourself.
npc.palimuth.say_6: Rumours travel fast in Yalahar. So the Yalahari will soon have some new toys at their disposal. I strongly doubt this has any positive effect.
npc.palimuth.say_7: Oh no! So that's the reason for the quara attacks! I will do my best to close these sewage pipes. We will have to use other drains.
npc.palimuth.say_8: You can be proud of your decision, my friend.
npc.palimuth.say_9: So do you want to side with me?

npc.palomino.say_8: I'll give you one of our experienced ones. Take care! Look out for low hanging branches.

npc.pukosch.say_3: Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.pydar.farewell_msg_1: May the fire in your heart never die, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.pydar.greet_msg_1: Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|! I can smell the scent of a phoenix on you!
npc.pydar.keyword_1: So receive the spark of the phoenix, pilgrim.
npc.pydar.stdmod_1: The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great geomancer of the local earth temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix for |BLESSCOST| gold?
npc.pydar.stdmod_10: May the great flame devour them all!
npc.pydar.stdmod_11: Life feeds on fire and ultimately fire will feed on life.
npc.pydar.stdmod_12: A weapon too powerful to be wielded by mortals. It has to be returned to the fire which gave birth to it.
npc.pydar.stdmod_13: If he ever dares enter Kazordoon I will gladly dump him into the lava. Tthe sacred flame shall bring justice upon him.
npc.pydar.stdmod_14: Our city was founded in ancient times. Abandoned by the gods we once fought for, we created a secure haven for our people.
npc.pydar.stdmod_15: This mountain is said to be the oldest in the world. It is the place where fire and earth meet and separate at the same time.
npc.pydar.stdmod_16: Bezil and Nezil are buying and selling equipment of all kinds.
npc.pydar.stdmod_17: Bezil and Nezil are buying and selling equipment of all kinds.
npc.pydar.stdmod_18: She is the first knight of Kazordoon. She is responsible for teaching our young warriors how to handle an axe.
npc.pydar.stdmod_19: Etzel is a true master of the elements. He is a role-model for our youngsters, jawoll.
npc.pydar.stdmod_2: So receive the spark of the phoenix, pilgrim.
npc.pydar.stdmod_20: He and his wife are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
npc.pydar.stdmod_21: He is a smith. If you are looking for exquisite weapons and armour just talk to him.
npc.pydar.stdmod_22: She and her husband are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
npc.pydar.stdmod_23: Uzgod is a weaponsmith just like those in the old legends.
npc.pydar.stdmod_24: Though we are through with the so-called gods, Durin, the first dwarf to aquire divine powers of his own, is considered a protector of our race.
npc.pydar.stdmod_25: Unlike the gods, the elements don't use mortals as toys, A skilled mind can understand and even control them to some extent.
npc.pydar.stdmod_26: The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
npc.pydar.stdmod_27: You can receive the Spiritual Shielding in the Whiteflower Temple south of Thais.
npc.pydar.stdmod_28: Ask for the Fire of the Suns in the Suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.pydar.stdmod_29: The druids north of Carlin can provide you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.pydar.stdmod_30: Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.pydar.stdmod_31: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes.
npc.pydar.stdmod_32: I'm the head pyromancer of Kazordoon. I guess you are here for healing or looking for a blessing.
npc.pydar.stdmod_33: There are five different blessings available in five sacred places. These blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.pydar.stdmod_4: The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
npc.pydar.stdmod_5: I am the head pyromancer of Kazordoon.
npc.pydar.stdmod_6: My name is Pydar Firefist, Son of Fire, from the Savage Axes.
npc.pydar.stdmod_7: Ask around. There's a lot to do, jawoll.
npc.pydar.stdmod_9: It's the fourth age of the yellow flame.
npc.pydar.walkaway_msg_1: May the fire in your heart never die.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.farewell_msg_1: COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_1: LIKE MY TREASURE? WANNA PICK SOMETHING OUT OF IT?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_10: YOU LITTLE MAGGOT. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU CAN HANDLE A FIGHT AGAINST MY KIND.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_11: I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_12: EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_13: I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_14: BOON AND BANE. I HAVE CHOSEN THIS LIFE VOLUNTARILLY AND I NEVER REGRET IT. MY {TREASURE} IS GROWING BIGGER EACH DAY.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_2: ALRIGHT. BUT FIRST OF ALL I WANT YOU TO BRING ME SOMETHING IN EXCHANGE. SURPRISE ME....AND IF I LIKE IT, YOU MAY GET WHAT YOU DESERVE.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_3: HAVE YOU SEEN THESE LEGENDARY ITEMS BACK THERE? WHO COULD REFUSE THE CHANCE OF OBTAINING ONE?!? SO WHAT IS YOUR ANSWER?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_4: I GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH. YOU'LL FIND SOME OF MY LIVING BROTHERS THERE....BUT.....EVERY TIME YOU WANT TO ENTER YOU HAVE TO GIVE ME SOMETHING PRECIOUS. ALRIGHT?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_5: AS YOU WISH. WHAT DO YOU HAVE TO OFFER?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_6: I LIKE THAT AND GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH FOR THE NEXT FEW MINUTES. COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME MORE TREASURES.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_7: THIS IS NOT WORTH BEING PART OF MY TREASURE! BRING ME SOMETHING ELSE.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_8: THIS IS NOT WORTH BEING PART OF MY TREASURE! BRING ME SOMETHING ELSE
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_9: TELL ME IF YOU CHANGE YOUR MIND. MY TREASURE THIRSTS FOR GOLD.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.walkaway_msg_1: COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.
npc.quandons_ghost.greet_msg_2: He murdered me. I shouldn't have trusted him! The money! All that money blinded me! To the east I brought his stuff. In night and darkness, covered by some kind of magic of his. The minotaurs did not bother us, like he promised. ...
npc.quandons_ghost.greet_msg_3: His ... his true name is Shargon and he is a priest of some kind. He belongs to a powerful secret society and is looking for something on their behalves. ...
npc.quandons_ghost.greet_msg_4: We brought his stuff to a hideout, I'll mark it on your map! The things that I've seen there! Horrible, horrible things! I fled, but he found me, killed me. He murdered me!
npc.queen_eloise.multi_1: Excellent! Now, let me explain. If you donate 1.000.000.000 gold pieces, you will be entitled to wear a unique outfit. ...
npc.queen_eloise.say_1: In exchange for a truly generous donation, I will offer a special outfit. Do you want to make a donation?
npc.queen_eloise.say_10: You need to donate {armor} outfit first.
npc.queen_eloise.say_11: [EN] Take this boots as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.queen_eloise.say_12: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.queen_eloise.say_14: You need to donate {helmet} addon first.
npc.queen_eloise.say_15: So you wold like to donate 500.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique armor?
npc.queen_eloise.say_16: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear unique helmet?
npc.queen_eloise.say_17: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique boots?
npc.queen_eloise.say_2: In that case, return to me once you made up your mind.
npc.queen_eloise.say_3: Take this armor as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend!
npc.queen_eloise.say_4: Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
npc.queen_eloise.say_5: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.queen_eloise.say_7: [EN] Take this helmet as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.queen_eloise.say_8: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_1: I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_10: I am Queen Eloise. For you it's 'My Queen' or 'Your Majesty', of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_11: I don't care about gossip like a simpleminded male would do.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_12: Soon the whole land will be ruled by women at last!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_15: Sell? Your question shows that you are a typical member of your gender!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_16: We honor the gods of good in our fair city, especially Crunor, of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_17: All citizens of Carlin are my subjects. I see them more as my childs, though, epecially the male population.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_18: This beast scared my cat away on my last diplomatic mission in this filthy town.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_19: He is the scourge of the whole continent!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_20: The royal treasure is hidden beyond the grasps of any thieves by magical means.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_21: Go and hunt them! For queen and country!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_22: Visit the church or the townguards for help.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_23: I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_24: Our city is rich and prospering.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_25: I don't want to talk about 'sewers'.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_26: Dungeons are places where males crawl around and look for trouble.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_27: Feel free to visit our town's magnificent shops.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_28: Don't worry about time in the presence of your Queen.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_29: We need the assistance of heroes now and then. Even males prove useful now and then.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_3: Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_30: The taxes in Carlin are not high, more a symbol than a sacrifice.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_31: I am the Queen, the only rightful ruler on the continent!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_32: Ask one of the soldiers about that.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_33: Our enemies are numerous. We have to fight vile monsters and have to watch this silly king in the south carefully.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_34: They dare to reject my reign over them!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_35: Isn't our city marvellous? Have you noticed the lovely gardens on the roofs?
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_36: My subjects maintain many fine shops. Go and have a look at their wares.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_38: The four major guilds are the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_39: They haven't troubled our city lately. I guess, they fear the wrath of our druids.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_4: I remember about those uniforms, they had a camouflage inlay so they could be worn the inside out too. I will send some color samples via mail to Mr. Postner.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_41: It's a shame that the High Paladin does not reside in Carlin.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_42: The knights of Carlin are the bravest.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_43: The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does not burn the whole city to ruins.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_44: The druids of Carlin are our protectors and advisors. Their powers provide us with wealth and food.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_45: Carlin is a center of the forces of good, of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_46: The forces of evil have a firm grip on this puny city to the south.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_47: The order, Crunor gives the world, is essential for survival.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_48: Chaos is common in the southern regions, where they allow a man to reign over a realm.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_49: A mans tale ... that means 'nonsense', of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_7: The uniforms of our guards and soldiers are of unparraleled quality of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_8: I am {Queen} Eloise. It is my duty to reign over this marvellous {city} and the {lands} of the north.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_9: We women try to bring justice and wisdom to all, even to males.
npc.quentin.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.quentin.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.quentin.stdmod_1: Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.quentin.stdmod_11: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.quentin.stdmod_14: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.quentin.stdmod_16: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.quentin.stdmod_18: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.quentin.stdmod_19: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.quentin.stdmod_2: I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.quentin.stdmod_20: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.quentin.stdmod_21: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.quentin.stdmod_22: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.quentin.stdmod_23: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.quentin.stdmod_24: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.quentin.stdmod_25: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.quentin.stdmod_26: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.quentin.stdmod_27: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.quentin.stdmod_28: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.quentin.stdmod_29: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.quentin.stdmod_3: Ah, I see you brought a stake with you. Are you ready to receive my line of the prayer then?
npc.quentin.stdmod_30: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.quentin.stdmod_32:
A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ... \z
	However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ... \z
	I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ... \z
	Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
npc.quentin.stdmod_33:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.quentin.stdmod_4: So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.quentin.stdmod_6: You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.quentin.stdmod_7: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.quentin.stdmod_8: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.quentin.stdmod_9: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.quentin.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.rabaz.greet_msg_1: Ah, a customer! Please feel free to browse my wares, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.rabaz.multi_1: Ah, thank you. Now look at that texture and fine colour, simply marvellous. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_10: If you lose it I will have to write a new one and put it in there again - which will undoubtedly take me a while. So keep an eye on it on your travels. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_11: Once you find what I need, best use a knife to carefully cut and gather a leaf or a scrap of their integument and press it directly under their appropriate entry into my botanical almanach. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_12: Simply return to me after you have done that and we will discuss your reward. What do you say, are you in?
npc.rabaz.multi_2: I hope the sun in the steppe did not exhaust you too much? Shellshock. A dangerous foe in the world of field science and exploration. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_3: Here, I always wore this comfortable hat when travelling, take it. It may be of use for you on further reconnaissances in Zao. Again you have my thanks, friend.
npc.rabaz.multi_4: Why yes, there is indeed some minor issue I could need your help with. I was always a friend of nature and it was not recently I discovered the joys of plants, growths, of all the flora around us. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_5: Botany my friend. The study of plants is of great importance for our future. Many of the potions we often depend on are made of plants you know. Plants can help us tending our wounds, cure us from illness or injury. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_6: I am currently writing an excessive compilation of all the knowledge I have gathered during my time here in Farmine and soon hope to publish it as 'Rabaz' Unabridged Almanach Of Botany'. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_7: However, to actually complete my botanical epitome concerning Zao, I would need someone to enter these dangerous lands. Someone able to get closer to the specimens than I can. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_8: And this is where you come in. There are two extremely rare species I need samples from. Typically not easy to come by but it should not be necessary to venture too far into Zao to find them. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_9: Explore the anterior outskirts of Zao, use my almanach and find the two specimens with missing samples on their pages. The almanach can be found in a chest in my storage, next to my shop. It's the door over there. ...
npc.rabaz.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rabaz.say_2: Yes? Yes! That's the enthusiasm I need! Remember to bring a sharp knife to gather the samples, plants - even mutated deformed plants - are very sensitive you know. Off you go and be careful out there, Zao is no place for the feint hearted mind you.
npc.rabaz.say_3: Oh, you don't have my book.
npc.rabaz.say_4: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rachel.say_1: So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
npc.rachel.say_2: What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
npc.rachel.say_3: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rachel.say_4: Sorry, you aren't a druid either a sorcerer.
npc.rachel.say_5: Here you are young adept, take care yourself.
npc.rachel.say_6: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rachel.stdmod_1: Okay, then just browse through all of my wares.
npc.raffael.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.raffael.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_1: Are you here to get a task or to report you finished task?
npc.rafzan.stdmod_10: They are mean and cruel. Humble goblin rarely trades with them. They would rather kill poor me if not too greedy for stuff only me can get them. Still, they rob me of it for a few spare coins and there is noooo profit for poor goblin.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_11: Me job merchant is. Me trade with all kinds of things. Me not good trader though, so you get everything incredibly cheap! You might think me mad, but please don't rip off poor goblin too much. Me has four or five wives and dozens of kids to feed!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_12: Humans so clever. Much, much smarter than poor, stupid goblin. They have big rich town. Goblin lives here poor and hungry. Me so impressed by you strong and smart humans. So much to learn from you. Poor goblin only sees pretty city from afar. Poor goblin too afraid to go there.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_13: Me have seen a gold coin once or twice. So bright and shiny it hurt me poor eyes. You surely are incredibly rich human who has even three or four coins at once! Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have no idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_14: Furry guys are strange fellows. Always collecting things and stuff. Not easy to make them share, oh there is noooo profit for little, poor me to be made. They build underground dens that can stretch quite far. Rumour has it the corym have strange tunnels that connect their different networks all over the world.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_2: Me humble name is Rafzan. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_3: Most goblins so afraid of everything, that they fight everything. Me different. Me just want trade.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_4: You humans are so big, strong, clever and beautiful. Me really feel little and green beside you. Must be sooo fun to be human. You surely always make profit!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_5: To be honest to me human friend, me only heard about it, never seen one. I imagine it's something cute and cuddly.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_6: Swamp is horrible. Slowly eating away at health of poor little goblin. No profit here at all. Me will die poor and desperate, probably eaten by giant mosquitoes.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_7: Beardmen are nasty. Always want to kill little goblin. No trade at all. Not good, not good.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_8: So much to do, so little help. Me poor goblin desperately needs help. Me have a few tasks me need to be done. I can offer you all money I made if you only help me a little with stuff which is easy to strong smart human but impossible for poor, little me.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_9: Me heard Thais is big city with king! Must be strong and clever, to become chief of all humans. Me cannot imagine how many people you have to beat up to become king of all humans. Surely he makes lot of profit in his pretty city.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_28: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_29: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_3: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_30: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_33:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_5: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_8: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.rahkem.voice_1: Please, not so loud, not so loud. Some of us are trying to rest in peace here.
