npc.rashid.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, may the winds guide your way.
npc.rashid.multi_1: My friend, it seems you have already learnt a lot about the art of trading. I think you are more than worthy to become a recognised trader. ...
npc.rashid.multi_10: Well, that's good to hear. From you as my trader and deliveryman, I expect more than bringing stinky cheese. ...
npc.rashid.multi_11: I wonder if you are able to deliver goods so fragile they almost break when looked at. ...
npc.rashid.multi_12: I have ordered a special elven vase from Briasol in Ab'Dendriel. Get it from him and don't even touch it, just bring it to me while I'm in Ankrahmun. Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_13: Well, that's good to hear. From you as my trader and deliveryman, I expect more than carrying heavy packages. ...
npc.rashid.multi_14: You also need to be fast and deliver wares in time. I have ordered a very special cheese wheel made from Darashian milk. ...
npc.rashid.multi_15: Unfortunately, the high temperature in the desert makes it rot really fast, so it must not stay in the sun for too long. ...
npc.rashid.multi_16: I'm also afraid that you might not be able to use ships because of the smell of the cheese. ...
npc.rashid.multi_17: Please get the cheese from Miraia and bring it to me while I'm in Port Hope. Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_18: Alright, that's good to hear. From you as my trader and deliveryman, I expect more than finding rare items. ...
npc.rashid.multi_19: You also need to be able to transport heavy wares, weaklings won't get far here. I have ordered a special package from Edron. ...
npc.rashid.multi_2: There is just one little favour that I would ask from you... something personal, actually, forgive my boldness. ...
npc.rashid.multi_20: Pick it up from Willard and bring it back to me while I'm in Liberty Bay. Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_21: Very good! I need talented people who are able to handle my wares with care, find good offers and the like, so I'm going to test you. ...
npc.rashid.multi_22: First, I'd like to see if you can dig up rare wares. Something like a ... mastermind shield! ...
npc.rashid.multi_23: Haha, just kidding, fooled you there, didn't I? Always control your nerves, that's quite important during bargaining. ...
npc.rashid.multi_24: Okay, all I want from you is one of these rare deer trophies. I have a customer here in Svargrond who ordered one, so I'd like you to deliver it tome while I'm in Svargrond. ...
npc.rashid.multi_3: I have always dreamed to have a small pet, one that I could take with me and which wouldn't cause problems. ...
npc.rashid.multi_4: Could you - just maybe - bring me a small goldfish in a bowl? I know that you would be able to get one, wouldn't you?
npc.rashid.multi_5: Fine! There's one more skill that I need to test and which is cruicial for a successful trader. ...
npc.rashid.multi_6: Of course you must be able to haggle, else you won't survive long in this business. To make things as hard as possible for you, I have the perfect trade partner for you. ...
npc.rashid.multi_7: [EN] Of course, it has to be cheap. Don't come back with anything more expensive than 400 gold. ...
npc.rashid.multi_8: [EN] And the quality must not suffer, of course! Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_9: And the quality must not suffer, of course! Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.say_1: Well, you could attempt the mission to become a recognised trader, but it requires a lot of travelling. Are you willing to try?
npc.rashid.say_10: Have you brought a cheap but good crimson sword?
npc.rashid.say_11: So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_12: Have you brought me a gold fish??
npc.rashid.say_13: Ah, right. <ahem> I hereby declare you - one of my recognised traders! Feel free to offer me your wares, just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.rashid.say_14: Fine. Then get a hold of that deer trophy and bring it to me while I'm in Svargrond. Just ask me about your mission.
npc.rashid.say_15: [EN] Well done! I'll take that from you. <snags it> Come see me another day, I'll be busy for a while now.
npc.rashid.say_16: Fine. Then off you go, just ask Willard about the 'package for Rashid'.
npc.rashid.say_17: [EN] Great. Just place it over there - yes, thanks, that's it. Come see me another day, I'll be busy for a while now.
npc.rashid.say_18: Okay, then please find Miraia in Darashia and ask her about the {'scarab cheese'}.
npc.rashid.say_19: [EN] Mmmhh, the lovely odeur of scarab cheese! I really can't understand why most people can't stand it. Thanks, well done!
npc.rashid.say_2: Have you managed to obtain a rare deer trophy for my customer?
npc.rashid.say_20: Okay, then please find {Briasol} in {Ab'Dendriel} and ask for a {'fine vase'}.
npc.rashid.say_21: I'm surprised that you managed to bring this vase without a single crack. That was what I needed to know, thank you.
npc.rashid.say_22: Okay, I'm curious how you will do with {Uzgod}. Good luck!
npc.rashid.say_23: Ha! You are clever indeed, well done! I'll take this from you. Come see me tomorrow, I think we two might get into business after all.
npc.rashid.say_24: Thanks so much! I'll be waiting eagerly for your return then.
npc.rashid.say_25: Thank you!! Ah, this makes my day! I'll take the rest of the day off to get to know this little guy. Come see me tomorrow, if you like.
npc.rashid.say_3: So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_4: Did you bring me the package?
npc.rashid.say_48: Sorry, but you do not belong to my exclusive customers. I have to make sure that I can trust in the quality of your wares.
npc.rashid.say_5: So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_7: So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_9: So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.sendtrade_msg_1: Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
npc.rashid.stdmod_1: I am a travelling trader. I don't buy everything, though. And not from everyone, for that matter.
npc.rashid.stdmod_10: Too few customers there, it's not worth the trip.
npc.rashid.stdmod_12: I don't like being underground much. I also tend to get lost in these labyrinthine dwarven tunnels, so I rather avoid them.
npc.rashid.stdmod_13: When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the governor's daughter.
npc.rashid.stdmod_15: I like the settlement itself, but I don't set my foot into the jungle. Have you seen the size of these centipedes??
npc.rashid.stdmod_17: I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
npc.rashid.stdmod_18: I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
npc.rashid.stdmod_2: I am Rashid, son of the desert.
npc.rashid.stdmod_20: Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
npc.rashid.stdmod_21: It's almost time to journey on.
npc.rashid.stdmod_22: Kings, queens, emperors and kaliphs... everyone claims to be different and unique, but actually it's the same thing everywhere.
npc.rashid.stdmod_3: Of course, old friend. You can also browse only armor, legs, shields, helmets, boots, weapons, enchanted weapons, jewelry or miscellaneous stuff.
npc.rashid.stdmod_4: Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
npc.rashid.stdmod_5: My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.
npc.rashid.stdmod_6: I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
npc.rashid.stdmod_7: Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
npc.rashid.stdmod_8: It's not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.
npc.rashid.stdmod_9: Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.

npc.rata_mari.greet_1: Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
npc.rata_mari.greet_msg_1: Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
npc.rata_mari.multi_1: You have come for the report? Great! I have been working hard on it during the last months. And nobody came to pick it up. I thought everybody had forgotten about me! ...
npc.rata_mari.multi_2: Do you have any idea how difficult it is to hold a pen when you have claws instead of hands? ...
npc.rata_mari.multi_3: But - you know - now I have worked so hard on this report I somehow don't want to part with it. At least not without some decent payment. ...
npc.rata_mari.multi_4: All right - listen - I know Fa'hradin would not approve of this, but I can't help it. I need some cheese! I need it now! ...
npc.rata_mari.multi_5: And I will not give the report to you until you get me some! Meep!
npc.rata_mari.say_1: Ok, have you brought me the cheese, I've asked for?
npc.rata_mari.say_2: I already gave you the report. I'm not going to write another one!
npc.rata_mari.say_4: Meep! Meep! Great! Here is the spyreport for you!
npc.rata_mari.stdmod_1: Your power of observation is stunning. Yes, I'm a rat.
npc.raymond_striker.greet_msg_1: Be greeted. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
npc.raymond_striker.multi_1: So you went into the leaders' hideout? I hope you were successful and got what you were looking for! Thank you, my friend. Pirates still keep coming here, unfortunately. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_10: It doesn't matter how long it takes, but... would you be willing to kill 3000 pirates for us?
npc.raymond_striker.multi_11: Incredible! You did what no other did even dare to think about! You are indeed a true hero to our cause ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_12: Sadly I have no ship that lacks a captain, else you would of course be our first choice. I am still true to my word asbest as I am able. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_13: So take this as your very own ship. Oh, and remind me about the pirate outfit sometime.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_14: Well done, my friend. That will help us a lot. Of course there are other things to be done though. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_15: I learned that Klaus, the owner of the tavern, wants me dead. He is offering any of those pirates a mission to kill me....
npc.raymond_striker.multi_16: If we could convince him that you fulfilled that mission, the pirates will have the party of their lives. This would beour chance for a sneak attack to damage their boats and steal their plunder! ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_17: Obtain this mission from him and learn what he needs as a proof. Then return to me and report to me about yourmission so we can formulate an appropriate plan.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_18: If you manage to accomplish this vital mission you will prove yourself to be a worthy member of our community. Imight even grant you your own ship and pirate clothing! ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_19: So listen to the first step of my plan. I want you to infiltrate their base. Try to enter their tavern, which meansthat you have to get past the guard. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_2: Do you, by chance, would like to kill pirates again for us?
npc.raymond_striker.multi_20: You will probably have to deceive him somehow, so that he thinks you are one of them. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_21: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_22: Afterwards, return here and report to me about your mission.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_23: The mission on which I will send you is vital to our cause. It is a sabotage mission. Nargor is guarded by several heavy catapults. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_24: I need you to sabotage the most dangerous of those catapults which can be found right in their harbour, aiming at ships passing by the entrance. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_25: Get a fire bug - you can buy them in Liberty Bay - and set this catapult on fire. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_26: Make sure to use the bug on the left part of the catapult where its lever is. That is where it's most vulnerable. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_27: If you see a short explosion, you will know that it worked. I will tell Sebastian to bring you to Nargor, but beware. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_28: Of course, he can't drop you off directly in the pirate's base. However, we have discovered a secret way into the Howling Grotto. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_29: Try to make your way through the caves of Nargor to reach their harbour. This is where you will find the catapult in question.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_3: This was probably the last time you will be able to enter that hideout. Well done, my friend, our thanks are with you. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_30: Indeed, I could use some help. The evil pirates of Nargor have convinced an alchemist from Edron to supply them with a substance called Fafnar's Fire ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_31: It can burn even on water and is a threat to us all. I need you to travel to Edron and pretend to the alchemist Sandra that you are the one whom the other pirates sent to get the fire ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_32: When she asks for a payment, tell her 'Your continued existence is payment enough'. That should enrage any member of the Edron academy enough to refuse any further deals with the pirates.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_4: You are most welcome to keep on killing pirates for us though for some bucks and experience. If you want to do so, just ask me about a {task} anytime.
npc.raymond_striker.multi_5: Hey, great. You've done well! As a small reward I give you some coins from our treasure box. Also, let me tell you an interesting piece of information. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_6: One of our spies told us about a secret hideout somewhere on Nargor. Supposedly, one of the four pirate leaders can be found there sometimes. If you dare go there, you might be able to face him or her in one on one combat. ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_7: Beware though - prepare yourself well and only flee if you must. This might be your only chance to get into there, so be careful and don't die!
npc.raymond_striker.multi_8: The pirates on Nargor are becoming more and more of a threat to us each day. I wish someone could get rid of them once and for all, but unfortunately they just keep coming! ...
npc.raymond_striker.multi_9: Only a dead pirate is a good pirate. I think killing a large number of them would definitely help us to make Sabrehaven a safer place. ...
npc.raymond_striker.say_1: Eleonore ... Yes, I remember her... vaguely. She is a pretty girl ... but still only a girl and now I am in love with a beautiful and passionate woman. A true {mermaid} even.
npc.raymond_striker.say_10: Ahh, thank you, my friend! What would we do without you? Here, take this reward for your efforts. If you want to continue to help us killing pirates, just ask me about that {task}.
npc.raymond_striker.say_12: Do you, by chance, would like to kill pirates again for us?
npc.raymond_striker.say_13: Perfect. I know it sounds like a lot, but really, take your time. You won't do it for nothing, I promise.
npc.raymond_striker.say_2: Don't ask about silly missions. All I can think about is this lovely {mermaid}.
npc.raymond_striker.say_3: Ask around in the settlement where you can help out. If you have proven your worth I might have some missions for you.
npc.raymond_striker.say_4: I think that means 'mission accomplished'. Hehe. I guess that will put an end to their efforts to buy any alchemical substance from Edron.
npc.raymond_striker.say_6: My pillow?? They know me all too well... <sigh> I've owned it since my childhood. However. Here, take it and convincehim that I am dead.
npc.raymond_striker.say_7: The mermaid is the most beautiful creature I have ever met. She is so wonderful. It was some kind of magic as we first met. A look in her eyes and I suddenly knew there would be never again another woman in my life but her.
npc.raymond_striker.say_8: I am deeply ashamed that I lacked the willpower to resist her spell. Thank you for your help in that matter. Now my head is once more free to think about our {mission}.
npc.raymond_striker.say_9: Ah, right! The pirate outfit! Here you go, now you are truly one of us.
npc.razan.ape_fur_ask: Have you really managed to fulfil the task and brought me 100 pieces of ape fur?
npc.razan.ape_fur_done: Ahhh, this softness! I'm impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. You're on the best way to earn that turban. Now, please retrieve 100 fish fins.
npc.razan.ape_fur_info: Only ape fur is good enough to touch the feet of our Caliph.
npc.razan.blue_cloth_ask: Ah, have you brought the 100 pieces of blue cloth?
npc.razan.blue_cloth_done: Ah! Congratulations - even if you are not a true weaponmaster, you surely deserve to wear this turban. Here, I'll tie it for you.
npc.razan.blue_cloth_info: It's a great material for turbans.
npc.razan.chicken_wings_ask: Were you able to get hold of two enchanted chicken wings?
npc.razan.chicken_wings_done: Great, thank you very much. Just bring me 100 pieces of blue cloth now and I will happily show you how to make a turban.
npc.razan.chicken_wings_info: Enchanted chicken wings are actually used to make boots of haste, so they could be magically extracted again. Djinns are said to be good at that.
npc.razan.fish_fins_ask: Were you able to discover the undersea race and retrieved 100 fish fins?
npc.razan.fish_fins_done: I never thought you'd make it, |PLAYERNAME|. Now we only need two enchanted chicken wings to start our waterwalking test!
npc.razan.fish_fins_info: I really wonder what the explorer society is up to. Actually I have no idea how they managed to dive unterwater.
npc.razan.greet_msg_1: Greetings |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
npc.razan.multi_1: Alright, then listen to the following requirements. We are currently in dire need of ape fur since the Caliph has requested a new bathroom carpet. ...
npc.razan.multi_2: Thus, please bring me 100 pieces of ape fur. Secondly, it came to our ears that the explorer society has discovered a new undersea race of fishmen. ...
npc.razan.multi_3: Their fins are said to allow humans to walk on water! Please bring us 100 of these fish fin. ...
npc.razan.multi_4: Third, if the plan of walking on water should fail, we need enchanted chicken wings to prevent the testers from drowning. Please bring me two. ...
npc.razan.multi_5: Last but not least, just drop by with 100 pieces of blue cloth and I will happily show you how to make a turban. ...
npc.razan.multi_6: Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.razan.say_1: My turban? Eh no, you can't have it. Only oriental weapon masters may wear it after having completed a difficult task.
npc.razan.say_2: You mean, you would like to prove that you deserve to wear such a turban?
npc.razan.say_3: Excellent! Come back to me once you have collected 100 pieces of ape fur.
npc.red_lilly.greet_msg_1: Hello sweetie. If you need general equipment, stuff like that, let me know.
npc.red_lilly.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. Remember that if you buy vials of oil, there's a deposit of 5 gold on the empty one.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_1: Come visit my little pawnshop! General equipment and such. Don't miss it!
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_10: What interest could a king have in this little settlement? If a king cares about us, there must be something important behind all this.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_11: Liberty comes, liberty goes, only the bay stays. Hehe.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_12: I sell torches, candelabra, and oil.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_13: That guy is a shrewd trader, sweetie. I bet even I could learn a thing or two from him.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_14: I have shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, scrolls, watches, some lightsources, and other stuff. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_15: Mostly, pirates are bad for business. But sometimes, they are good for business.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_16: Sadly the workers have hardly enough money to buy something to eat and to drink. That is bad also for my business.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_17: Ah, there is little in the world that comes close to the taste of rum.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_18: I heard there is a fine bounty on his head. Would be a shame though to lose such a handsome man to the executioner <winks>.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_19: Sugar lets the money flow. We depend heavily on it.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_2: Just between you and me hun, that woman is a witch. Love potions, poison, voodoo dolls to torture your neighbour. You name it, she got it.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_20: Thais might be a splendid town, but this is of no use to us here. The situation in our town gets worse with every ship full of foreigners that arrives here.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_21: I heard Venore will soon acquire several trade monopolies that will grant them wealth for centuries.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_22: Well, <lowers the voice to a whisper> there are several people around who know this or that about voodoo and not all of them are up to something good. Just buy some lucky charms from that old hag Charlotta to be on the safe side.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_23: A handsome man but a bit too stiff. I think no one has ever had a chance to see him smiling.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_24: I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial. Ok?
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_25: Hmm, but please keep Tibia litter free.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_27:
The quara are the curse of the sea. Everybody that dares to enrage the sea spirits has to fear their vengeance. They come at night to kidnap people who forgot their lucky charms at home ... \z
	Sometimes those evil beings take the most naughty children to raise them as their own underwater.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_3: Uh! <whispers> There are ... rumours, you know? About bloody rituals and gruesome curses ... better don't talk aloud about such issues.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_4: Kshh!! No talks about ... the magic folk here ... This might draw their attention.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_5: Hard to imagine that this fat man has such a pretty daughter.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_6: Don't mention HIM in my house you fool. You call evil and mayhem upon us.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_7: I am not dealing with food.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_8: I won't say anything bad about such a high-born person. That's why I remain silent hun .
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_9: I run this little pawnshop, hun, but I think you knew that already.
npc.red_lilly.voice_1: Come visit my little pawnshop! General equipment and such. Don't miss it!
npc.reed.say_1: You have NO idea what we have to endure each day .. <gives a shocking and disturbing report>.
npc.reed.say_2: You can {pass} either to the {Cemetery Quarter} or {Magician Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.rehon.say_1: By the Gods! You have the key to the cell! Thank you sooo much, mate. And now leave. I'll wait here until the air is clean and then I'm out of here.
npc.richard.greet_msg_1: Hello there, mate. Here for a {trade}? My stock's just been refilled.
npc.richard.say_1: I was a carpenter, back on Main. Wanted my own little shop. Didn't sit with the old man. So I shipped to somewhere else. Terrible storm.
npc.richard.say_2: Woke up on this island. Had to eat squirrels before the adventurers found me and took me in. End of story.
npc.richard.say_3: Only the best quality, I assure you. A rope in need is a friend indeed! Imagine you stumble into a rat hole without a rope - heh, your bones will be gnawed clean before someone finds ya!
npc.richard.say_4: Now, about that rope - ask me for {equipment} to see my wares. <winks>
npc.richard.say_5: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.richard.stdmod_1: Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Buy one here, only the best quality!
npc.richard.stdmod_10:
You know, I really don't want to poke into someone else's private life. \z
			Suffice it to say that everyone has chapters of his life he doesn't want to mention. \z
			Judging by Coltrayne's looks, we're looking at a trilogy here.
npc.richard.stdmod_11:
Old Inigo was the one who found me, actually, and brought me to the outpost. \z
			I was half starved by then. He taught me how to make better traps and how to fish... I owe much to Inigo.
npc.richard.stdmod_2: Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can buy one here now!
npc.richard.stdmod_4: A rope is the adventurer's best friend!
npc.richard.stdmod_5: Fresh meat! Durable provisions! Ropes and shovels!
npc.richard.stdmod_6:
Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? \z
		Buy a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!
npc.richard.stdmod_7: Richard. Just Richard. Lost my surname with my past in that storm. <winks>
npc.richard.stdmod_8:
This lovely island here. Once I didn't have to live off squirrels, it became quite enjoyable. \z
			Nasty things though live underground, so take care where you tread and ALWAYS have a rope with you!
npc.richard.stdmod_9: <shrugs> Never been, mate. Heard it's kinda cute, though.
npc.richard.voice_1: Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Buy one here, only the best quality!
npc.richard.voice_2: Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can buy one here now!
npc.richard.voice_4: A rope is the adventurer's best friend!
npc.richard.voice_5: Fresh meat! Durable provisions! Ropes and shovels!
npc.richard.voice_6:
Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? \z
		Buy a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!
npc.riddler.farewell_msg_1: HEHEHE! I knew you don't have the stomach.
npc.riddler.greet_msg_1: |PLAYERNAME| HEHEHEHE! Another fool visits the {tower}! Excellent!
npc.riddler.say_1: [EN] FOOL! Now you're doomed! But well ... \z So be it! Let's start out with the Seal of Knowledge and the first question: \z What name did the necromant king choose for himself?
npc.riddler.say_10: HOHO! You have learned your lesson well. Question number two then: Who or what is the feared Hugo?
npc.riddler.say_11: Hm. I bet you think you're smart. All right. How about this: What does everybody want to become but nobody to be?
npc.riddler.say_12: UHM UH OH ... How could you guess that? Are you mad??? All right. Penultimate question: What is the opposite?
npc.riddler.say_13: NO! NO! NO! That can't be true. You're not only mad, you are a complete idiot! Ah well. Here is the last question: What is 1 plus 1?
npc.riddler.say_16: WRONG! Next time get your own answers. To hell with thee, cheater Sischfried!
npc.riddler.say_2: [EN] HOHO! You have learned your lesson well. \z Question number two then: Who or what is the feared Hugo?
npc.riddler.say_3: [EN] Hm. I bet you think you're smart. All right. \z How about this: What does everybody want to become but nobody to be?
npc.riddler.say_4: [EN] UHM UH OH ... How could you guess that? Are you mad??? All right. \z Penultimate question: What is the opposite?
npc.riddler.say_5: [EN] NO! NO! NO! That can't be true. You're not only mad, you are a complete idiot! \z Ah well. Here is the last question: What is 1 plus 1?
npc.riddler.say_6: That was an easy one. Let's try the second: If you name it, you break it.
npc.riddler.say_7: ARGH! You did it again! Well all right. Do you wish to break the Seal of Madness?
npc.riddler.say_8: GOOD! So I will get you at last. Answer this: What is your favourite colour?
npc.riddler.say_9: FOOL! Now you're doomed! But well ... So be it! Let's start out with the Seal of Knowledge and the first question: What name did the necromant king choose for himself?
npc.riddler.stdmod_1: This tower, of course, silly one. It holds my {master'}s {treasure}.
npc.riddler.stdmod_2: His name is none of your business
npc.riddler.stdmod_3: I am guarding the treasures of the tower. Only those who pass the {test} of the three sigils may pass.
npc.riddler.stdmod_4: I am known as the riddler. That is all you need to know.
npc.riddler.stdmod_5: I am the guardian of the paradox tower.
npc.riddler.stdmod_6: The key of this tower! You will never find it! A malicious plant spirit is guarding it!.
npc.robson.greet_msg_1: Hrmpf, I'd say welcome if I felt like lying.
npc.robson.say_1: Do you want to buy a parcel for 15 gold?
npc.robson.say_2: Do you want to buy a label for 1 gold?
npc.robson.say_3: Sorry, that's only dust in your purse.
npc.robson.say_5: Sorry, that's only dust in your purse.
npc.robson.say_7: I knew I would be stuck with that stuff.
npc.robson.voice_2: Just great. Getting stranded on a remote underground isle was not that bad but now I'm becoming a tourist attraction!
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.farewell_msg_1: Promise to come back sometime, will ya?
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.greet_msg_1: Everyone on this island has gone crazy! Except for me and you, it seems. Let's {trade} like normal people would.
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.say_2: You would be surprised how many things are washed ashore here. I trade {}.
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_1: Have you noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to announce: I'm a trader
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_2: No, you got it all wrong! I said I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place!
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_3: I can help you buy trading stuff with you. Good for me, good for you. It's a win-win!
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_4: Have you noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to announce: I'm a trader
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.walkaway_msg_1: Hey! Don't leave me alone with all these lunatics!
npc.rock_steady.multi_1: Have you got anything... what? You want what? A reward? HAHAHAHAAAA!! ...
npc.rock_steady.multi_2: No I'm just teasing you. I'm really happy about my collection now. ...
npc.rock_steady.multi_3: Well, I found some kind of weapon a long time ago. I believe it may be especially helpful underwater as it is from the deep folk. In any case it is of more use for you than it would be for me.
npc.rock_steady.multi_4: I collect everything that reflects light in strange ways. However, I am bored by my collection. And there wasn't anything new to add for years. ...
npc.rock_steady.multi_5: I like pearls for example - but I have already enough. I also like shells - but I can't even count how many I already own. ...
npc.rock_steady.multi_6: If you find anything of REAL VALUE - bring it to me. I will reward you well. You don't already have something for me by chance?
npc.rock_steady.say_1: If you want anything, you should talk to Old Rock Boy over there. I do {collect} stuff, though. So just ask if you're interested in helping me.
npc.rock_steady.say_2: Have you got anything for me today?
npc.rock_steady.say_3: Have you got anything for me today?
npc.rock_steady.say_4: Great! Let me see. Amazing! I will take this, thank you!
npc.rock_steady.say_5: Great! Let me see. Amazing! I will take this, thank you!
npc.rock_steady.say_6: Great! Let me see. Amazing! I will take this, thank you!
npc.rock_steady.say_7: You dont have the required items!
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.greet_msg_1: Welcome, this is the {Gray Beach temple}, |PLAYERNAME|. Whether you are wounded, poisoned - or wait, don't tell me - yes, this is probably a case of being more emotionally hurt, I will do my best to {heal} you.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_11: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_12: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_13: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_14: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_15: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_16: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_17: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_18: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_19: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_20: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_21: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_22: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_23: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_25:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.rokyn.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.rokyn.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.romella.farewell_msg_1: Goodbye and please bring more gold next time <chuckles>. I mean, it would be nice to see you again.
npc.romella.greet_msg_1: I welcome thee, |PLAYERNAME|! I suppose you are looking for a trade in fine weapons!
npc.romella.stdmod_1: Check out my good and sturdy weapons!
npc.romella.stdmod_2: I am Romella and I will be serving you today.
npc.romella.stdmod_3: I have many weapons to offer. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.romella.stdmod_4: I sell and buy weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.romella.stdmod_5: Our warehouse is the main supplier of the local garrison.
npc.romella.stdmod_6: It says the amazons are looking for a certain magical weapon in this area.
npc.romella.stdmod_7: I wonder how they finance themselves. I bet they are secretly trading in some strange stuff.
npc.romella.stdmod_8: Make sure to buy some extra weapons before facing that one.
npc.romella.stdmod_9: I heard the amazons are after it.
npc.romella.voice_1: Check out my good and sturdy weapons!
npc.romir.greet_msg_1: Greetings, traveller. I'm a magical trader and trainer for sorcerer spells. How may I help you?
npc.romir.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rose.say_1: Do you want to buy a Hydra Tongue for 100 gold?
npc.rose.say_2: Here you are. A Hydra Tongue!
npc.roswitha.greet_msg_1: Hello, my lad. Sit down, have a drink, why don't you?
npc.roswitha.say_1: I'm sorry, but Harsin no longer lives here. He ordered a local named Quandon to transport all his stuff somewhere. I don't know where he moved, but Quandon should be able to help you with this information.
npc.rotem_valos.voice_1: <sigh> The world has grown complicated since my youth.
npc.rottin_wood.greet_msg_1: Hunter's greeting! I assume you want something from me since you came all the way out here on your own. This is a dangerous place to be, I doubt that all my men will accept strangers like I do. You don't seem to have any problems with that, though.
npc.rottin_wood.multi_1: Alright very good. Now the only thing you need to do is taking these traps and moving out to the area I have marked on your map where you need to place them. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_10: There is but a tiny little catch - we cannot help you laying these traps. You know, some of the guys became sick recently, we talk about several broken legs here, one almost lost his arm ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_11: So... it's entirely up to you, will you do this or not?
npc.rottin_wood.multi_12: Mmmmh, I have to say - good workmanship. No doubt. Yes, the person who made that tool you used to fix all this was a pure professional. Something I can't say about your work, though. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_13: The walls look as if they will come off in a matter of hours. Oh well, you can always come back and repair this mess, ask me for a task if you want to. Yeah, yeah and here's your reward for today.
npc.rottin_wood.multi_14: Fine, now hurry into the woods and find some rabbits. Find them and kill them that is. Use a sharp, thin knife to get the rabbit foot and be careful not to destroy it - no one would buy it in a bad condition after all. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_15: Once you gathered some rabbit feet, put one of our - handcrafted by the guys - ribbons on each of them. That will make two lucky charms per rabbit. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_16: We will need at least seven. And seven is a lucky number, don't you think? Heh. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_17: If you need some more ribbons just come back to me and ask.
npc.rottin_wood.multi_18: Oh |PLAYERNAME| my good friend, good to see you! Today you will help us with a very important task. Very important indeed. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_19: You know, a large group of merchants is travelling from Thais to Venore and they are crossing the forest to shorten their way - can you believe it? ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_2: Once you did that go to the large high seat near the camp and watch for the travelling merchants. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_20: They will enter the forest near our camp which is where you come in - uhm I mean you do want to help us with this, right?
npc.rottin_wood.multi_21: Of course, of course, there is indeed something you can help us with. Remember that we also have some tasks for you. So, are you ready for another quest to help the men of the forest?
npc.rottin_wood.multi_22: There is a problem with one of our deer stands. Right. Well, there are two problems, our deer stands - and some of the walls of the buildings in the camp are broken. ...
npc.rottin_wood.multi_23: You know, the guys built all of that themselves. Sure, at first it didn't quite work out as we planned and in the end we had to tear down half the forest - but - it was worth it. ...

npc.rottin_wood.say_10: Good, because that is exactly what you will help us with - getting more 'lucky charms'. If we won't get our hands on new charms in time, we will surely have to starve... during the autumn. That would be a hard time for all of us. So... you in?
npc.rottin_wood.say_11: Good hunt. That will be enough to help us uhm... get through the winter yes. Now if you want to help us getting even more lucky charms, you can always ask.
npc.rottin_wood.say_12: You do not have sufficient rabbit's foot.
npc.rottin_wood.say_13: Good, good. Do you remember the old saying? If it ain't broken, it was not made by us. Now, off you go!

npc.rottin_wood.say_3: Good to see you back. Now, did you bring us the lucky charms?

npc.rottin_wood.say_5: Ah there you are. So, did you repair all the broken structures?

npc.rottin_wood.say_7: You need to wait some hours to take another mission again or you are still on a mission.

npc.rottin_wood.say_9: You need to wait some hours to take another mission again or you are still on a mission.

npc.sandra.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, welcome to the fluid and potion {shop} of Edron.
npc.sandra.multi_1: The Edron academy has introduced a bonus system. Each time you deposit 100 vials without claiming the money for it, you will receive a lottery ticket. ...
npc.sandra.multi_2: Some of these lottery tickets will grant you a special potion belt accessory, if you bring the ticket to me. ...
npc.sandra.multi_3: If you join the bonus system now, I will ask you each time you are bringing back 100 or more vials to me whether you claim your deposit or rather want a lottery ticket. ...
npc.sandra.multi_4: Of course, you can leave or join the bonus system at any time by just asking me for the 'bonus'. ...
npc.sandra.multi_5: Would you like to join the bonus system now?
npc.sandra.say_1: We have a special offer right now for depositing vials. Are you interested in hearing it?
npc.sandra.say_10: Sorry, but you don't have your lottery ticket with you.
npc.sandra.say_11: Finally. You have no idea how difficult it is to keep something secret here. And you brought me all the crystal coins I demanded?
npc.sandra.say_2: Would you like to get a lottery ticket instead of the deposit for your vials?
npc.sandra.say_3: Are you here to claim a prize?
npc.sandra.say_4: Pssht, not that loud. So they have sent you to get... the stuff?
npc.sandra.say_5: What?? How dare you?! I am a sorcerer of the most reknown academy on the face of this world. Do you think some lousy pirates could scare me? Get lost! Now! I will have no further dealings with the likes of you!
npc.sandra.say_6: Great! I've signed you up for our bonus system. From now on, you will have the chance to win the potion belt addon!
npc.sandra.say_7: Alright, thank you very much! Here is your lottery ticket, good luck. Would you like to deposit more vials that way?
npc.sandra.say_8: Sorry, but you don't have 100 empty flasks or vials of the SAME kind and thus don't qualify for the lottery. Would you like to deposit the vials you have as usual and receive 5 gold per vial?

npc.sane_mage.greet_msg_1: ...er... hello? Yes...? Well, if... if you have any questions - I am not even here.
npc.sane_mage.multi_1: My experiments, my work - not at the moment, however. I'm on vacation. Trying to get away from it... it's all not right. Why... why am I doing this anyway.
npc.sane_mage.multi_2: NO! I should not talk like that, I just... I shouldn't. That's not even ME. I... I used to be MAD. A MAD SCIENTIST! THE BEST! THE... the... WORST! A SUPERLATIVE! Ah, nevermind.
npc.sane_mage.multi_3: [EN] Not... right now, though. I am currently... on {vacation}. {Vacation}, yes. All my experiments went wrong. WRONG. Everything. I tried everything but still.
npc.sane_mage.multi_4: [EN] It's always the same, the {fungus} grows, I am EXCITED and... well... WHAAAAAM! It just EXPLODES! It spreads, covers everything.
npc.sane_mage.multi_5: [EN] At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
npc.sane_mage.multi_6: [EN] However, sometimes people come and just... DESTROY them! Destroy my work!! Why? Do those people help me removing the slime instead? NO! Not at all.
npc.sane_mage.multi_7: [EN] All they do is ruining my experiments, my perfect testing conditions. It makes me just FURIOUS! And boy do I get FURIOUS, I tell you.
npc.sane_mage.multi_8: All they do is ruining my experiments, my perfect testing conditions. It makes me just FURIOUS! And boy do I get FURIOUS, I tell you.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_1: Hm? What is the meaning of all this?

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_3: Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... not?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_4: I AM THE... I mean... I am - what is a mage, if he is not {mad}? If he isn't... raging? I am... I am just sane. A sane mage.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_5: I am not mad... I- YES, that's the whole problem, isn't it? What's going on, what's happening to me? I don't even know anymore.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_6: Yes, well... I'm taking a break. It will take some time. I don't know how long I just... I want to get away from all this for some time, that's it.

npc.santiago.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, nice to see you on Rookgaard! I saw you walking by and wondered if you could help me. Could you? Please, say {yes}!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_2: Oh, |PLAYERNAME|, it's you again! It's probably impolite to disturb a busy adventurer like you, but I really need help. Please, say {yes}!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_3: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Ahh, you found my chest. Let me take a look at you. You put on that coat, {yes}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_4: Hey, I want to give you a weapon for free! You should not refuse that, in fact you should say '{yes}'!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_5: Good job! For that, I'll grant you 100 experience points! Oh - what was that? I think you advanced a level, {right}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_6: Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I asked you if you saw your 'level up'! You did, {right}?
npc.santiago.multi_1: Here, take this fish which I've caught myself. Find it in your inventory, then 'Use' it to eat it. This will slowly refill your health. ...
npc.santiago.multi_2: By the way: If your hitpoints are below 150, you will regenerate back to 150 hitpoints after few seconds as long as you are not hungry, outside a protection zone and do not have a battle sign. {Easy}, yes?
npc.santiago.say_1: Oh, what's wrong? As I said, simply go to my house south of here and go upstairs. Then come back and we'll continue our chat.
npc.santiago.say_10: That's just great! Now you have more health points, can carry more stuff and walk faster. Talking about health, did you get {hurt} by those cockroaches?
npc.santiago.say_11: Really? You look fine to me, must have been just a scratch. Well, there are much more dangerous monsters than cockroaches out there. Take a look at your status bar. You have 155 Health right now. I'll show you something, {yes}?
npc.santiago.say_12: This is an important lesson from me - an experienced veteran fighter. Take this! Look at your status bar again. As you can see, you've lost health. Now I'll tell you how to heal that, {yes}?
npc.santiago.say_13: I knew you'd get it right away. You can loot food from many creatures, such as deer and rabbits. You can find them in the forest nearby. By the way... have you seen {Zirella}?
npc.santiago.say_14: Really?? She was looking for someone to help her. Maybe you could go and see her. She lives just to the east and down the mountain. So, thank you again and {bye} for now!
npc.santiago.say_15: This is an important lesson from me - an experienced veteran fighter. Take this! Look at your status bar again. As you can see, you've lost health. Now I'll tell you how to heal that, {yes}?
npc.santiago.say_16: I knew I could count on you. Here, take this good and sturdy weapon in your hand. Then go back to my house and down the ladder. Good luck, and {bye} for now!
npc.santiago.say_17: I knew you'd get it right away. You can loot food from many creatures, such as deer and rabbits. You can find them in the forest nearby. By the way... have you seen {Zirella}?
npc.santiago.say_2: I've forgotten to tell you something. Of course I need proof that you killed cockroaches. Please bring me at least 3 of their legs. Good luck!
npc.santiago.say_3: I've forgotten to tell you something. Of course I need proof that you killed cockroaches. Please bring me at least 3 of their legs. Good luck!
npc.santiago.say_4: Great, please go to my house, just a few steps south of here. Upstairs in my room, you'll find a chest. You can keep what you find inside of it! Come back after you got it and greet me to talk to me again. {Yes}?
npc.santiago.say_5: Alright! Do you see the button called 'Quest Log'? There you can check the status of quests, like this one. {Bye} for now!
npc.santiago.say_6: Ah, no need to say anything, I can see it suits you perfectly. Now we're getting to the fun part, let's get you armed! Are you ready for some {action}?
npc.santiago.say_7: Oh, you don't wear it properly yet. You need to drag and drop it from your bag to your armor slot. Here, let me show you again. Is it a little {clearer} now?
npc.santiago.say_8: Oh no, did you lose my coat? Well, lucky you, I have a spare one here. Don't lose it again! Now we're getting to the fun part, let's get you armed! Are you ready for some {action}?
npc.santiago.say_9: I knew I could count on you. Here, take this good and sturdy weapon in your hand. Then go back to my house and down the ladder. Good luck, and {bye} for now!
npc.santiago.voice_1: Evil little beasts... I hope someone helps me fight them.
npc.santiago.voice_3: Hey! You over there, could you help me with a little quest? Just say 'hi' or 'hello' to talk to me!
npc.santiago.voice_4: Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'hello' or 'hi'!
npc.santiago.walkaway_msg_1: Good bye traveller, and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
npc.sarina.greet_msg_1: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.sarina.say_1: Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.sarina.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
npc.sarina.voice_1: General equipment and all sorts of goods. Visit my store!
npc.scott.voice_1: Hey there, adventurer! Need a little rest in my inn? Have some food!
npc.scrutinon.greet_msg_1: |PLAYERNAME|. I have been watching your fate for quite some time. It's about time you came here. Do you seek to enter the riven island of Quirefang or travel back from where you came?
npc.scrutinon.multi_1: He travelled on the very ground to reach the hostile shores of Quirefang. He used something that turned the soil and carved a way to the island. ...
npc.scrutinon.multi_2: You will need to follow his trail if you want to reach it.
npc.scrutinon.multi_3: This island is cleft. Go there only prepared or you will meet your end. The surface of this forgotten rock is a barren wasteland full of hostile creatures. ...
npc.scrutinon.multi_4: Its visage is covered with holes and tunnels in which its leggy inhabitants are hiding. Its bowels filled with the strangest creatures, waiting to feast on whatever dares to disturb their hive. ...
npc.scrutinon.multi_5: And you will find no shelter in Quirefang's black depths, where the creatures of the deep are fulfilling a dark prophecy. ...
npc.scrutinon.multi_6: It is impossible to reach it by ship or boat. However, there was one before you. A {visitor} who found a way to enter the island.
npc.scrutinon.stdmod_2: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.scrutinon.stdmod_3:
My name is Scrutinon. However, there are not many people calling my name nowadays. Not many captains even dare to land on this island. It is too close to {Quirefang}. ... \z
	Most of them do not know this island by that name. Some call it Demon Horn, others the Dragon's Tooth or the Gray Beach as none of them ever came closer than a fair distance. ... \z
	There are drifts and storms surrounding that place that are far too dangerous to navigate through even for the most versed captains. They often sail not closer than to this island here and drop off whoever dares to explore near this dreaded coast.
npc.sebastian.greet_msg_1: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.sebastian.say_1: Do you want to sail Nargor for 50 gold coins?
npc.sebastian.stdmod_1: Do you want to sail {0} for {1}?
npc.sebastian.stdmod_2: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.sebastian.stdmod_3: Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Nargor}?
npc.sebastian.stdmod_4: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian.stdmod_5: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian_nargor.greet_msg_1: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_1: Do you want to sail {0} for {1}?
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_2: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_3: Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Meriana}?
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_4: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_5: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.ser_tybald.greet_msg_1: Welcome, child. Have you come to learn about {magic}? Then you are in the right place. I can teach you many useful {spells}.
npc.ser_tybald.say_1: Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_10: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_11: Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
npc.ser_tybald.say_12: Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_13: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to know more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_14: I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
npc.ser_tybald.say_15: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_16: However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
npc.ser_tybald.say_2: There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_3: Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_4: Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_5: The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_6: There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.ser_tybald.say_7: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and quests than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_8: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have enough gold! ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_9: The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable knowledge of a spell to a novice if they can pay the price.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_1: In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_10: Roughened and toughened by life's tragedies. A good man, but somber.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_11: Yes, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_12:
A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		No respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_13:
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do not know. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_14:
Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Not very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_15:
Not a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, \z
		it seems to have lead him to discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_16:
He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of spells for knights and paladins. \z
		If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_17:
Ah, yes. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_2:
In this category I have '{Findperson}', '{Magicrope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', \z
		'{Greatlight}', '{Haste}', '{Poisonfield}', '{Firefield}', '{Lightmagicmissile}' and '{Energyfield}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_4:
I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells} and {attack spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_6:
Did you not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_7: I have an old friend there. Haven't heard from him in a while.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_8:
Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_9:
A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any question, ask Inigo for help.
npc.serafin.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my fruit and vegetable store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you'd like to see my wares.
npc.serafin.say_1: Oh, no I don't sell cookies. Or, do you mean you'd like to give me one?
npc.serafin.say_2: It'd be better for you to leave now.
npc.serafin.say_3: COUGH?! What kind of a mean trick is that? Get out of my shop!
npc.serafin.stdmod_1: There's something about these words which makes me feel awkward. Or maybe it's you who causes that feeling. You better get lost.
npc.servant_sentry.greet_msg_1: The. Slime. Has. Entered. Our. Master. Has. Left! We. Must. Help.
npc.servant_sentry.say_4: The. {Slime}. Has. Entered. Our. {Master}. Has. Left! We. Must. {Help}.
npc.servant_sentry.say_5: Defeat. {Slime}. We. Will. Why. Did. You. Kill. Us? Do. You. Want. To. Rectify. And. Help?
npc.servant_sentry.say_6: Then. Take. This. Gobbler. Always. Hungry. Eats. Slime. Fungus. Go.
npc.seymour.farewell_1: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.greet_1: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.say_1: Have you brought {0} dead rats to me to pick up your reward?
npc.seymour.say_2: Hmmm, let me look at you. You got that intelligent sparkle in your eyes and you'd love to handle great power - that must be a future sorcerer!
npc.seymour.say_3: Hmmm, let me look at you. You have an aura of great wisdom and may have healing hands as well as a sense for the powers of nature - I think you're a natural born druid!
npc.seymour.say_4: Hmmm, let me look at you. You seem to have keen eyes and a steady hand - I bet you'd make an excellent paladin!
npc.seymour.say_5: Hmmm, let me look at you. Strong and sturdy, with a determined look in your eyes - no doubt the knight profession would be suited for you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_1: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
npc.seymour.stdmod_10: Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_100: Dixi sells and buys {armors}, {shields}, {helmets} and {legs}. You can find her shop south of the academy, just go up the stairs in {Obi}'s shop.
npc.seymour.stdmod_101: A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He sells small health {potions} just like {Lily}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_102: Lee'Delle's shop is in the western part of town, on the {premium} side. She sells everything cheaper.
npc.seymour.stdmod_103: In the southern part of town, Lily sells {potions} which might come in handy once you are deep in a dungeon and need {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_11: HEY! You don't have so many!
npc.seymour.stdmod_12: Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_13: Have you brought a dead rat to me to pick up your reward?
npc.seymour.stdmod_14: Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_15: HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_16: Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_17: Do you have a suitable present box for me?
npc.seymour.stdmod_18: THANK YOU! Here is a helmet that will serve you well.
npc.seymour.stdmod_19: HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_2: Get some training in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_20: Well, I would like to send our king a little present but I do not have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.
npc.seymour.stdmod_21: You are pretty inexperienced. I think killing rats is a suitable challenge for you. For each fresh {dead rat} I will give you two shiny coins of gold.
npc.seymour.stdmod_22: For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young lady!
npc.seymour.stdmod_23: For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young man!
npc.seymour.stdmod_24: This is an island with {vocation} teachers. You can learn all about the different vocations there once you are level 8.
npc.seymour.stdmod_25: It's |TIME|, so you are late. Hurry!
npc.seymour.stdmod_26: My name is Seymour, but for you I am 'Sir' Seymour.
npc.seymour.stdmod_27: At least you know how to address a man of my importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_28: I'm the master of this fine {academy}, giving {lessons} to my students.
npc.seymour.stdmod_29: Oh, which lesson did you want to attend again? Was it {Rookgaard}, {fighting}, {equipment}, {citizens}, the {academy} or the {oracle}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_3: Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
npc.seymour.stdmod_30: In a bank you can deposit your earned gold coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.
npc.seymour.stdmod_31: Yes, depositing your money will keep it safe, so it is a good idea to store it in the bank. Of course, you can always withdraw it again.
npc.seymour.stdmod_32: Well, the {king} doesn't send troops anymore, the {academy} is dreadfully low on money, and the end of the world is pretty nigh. Apart from that I'm reasonably fine, I suppose.
npc.seymour.stdmod_33: Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any non-player character and I will tell you something about him or her.
npc.seymour.stdmod_34: Merchants buy and sell goods. Just ask them for a {trade} to see what they offer or buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_35: Trolls are quite nasty monsters which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!
npc.seymour.stdmod_36: The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {monsters} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.
npc.seymour.stdmod_37: There are four vocations: {knights}, {paladins}, {sorcerers} and {druids}. You can choose your vocation once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_38: Sorcerers are talented elemental magicians. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_39: Knights are strong melee fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_4: Gain some knowledge in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_40: Druids are nature magic users and great healers. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_41: Paladins are swift distance fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_42: We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the north-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_43: The world of Tibia is very large with tons of places to explore. Vast deserts, Caribbean islands, deep jungles, green meadows and jagged mountains await you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_44: The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.seymour.stdmod_45: Your current health is shown by the red bar on the right side. {Death} awaits you if it goes down to zero.
npc.seymour.stdmod_46: Dying in Tibia is painful, so try to avoid it. You will lose part of your {experience} points and also equipment. Make sure your {health} always stays up!
npc.seymour.stdmod_47: You gain experience when fighting {monsters}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.
npc.seymour.stdmod_48: Good monsters to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_49: One entrance to the sewers is south of this {academy}. Look for a sewer grate, then use it to climb down.
npc.seymour.stdmod_5: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_50: The academy is the building you are standing in. We have a {library}, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_51: There are many books in the bookcases around you, unless some naughty kids stole them again. Read them for more and detailed information.
npc.seymour.stdmod_52: Don't go hunting without proper equipment. You need at least a suitable {weapon}, {armor}, {shield}, {rope} and {shovel}. A {torch} is also good as well as {legs}, a {helmet} and {shoes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_53: Make money by killing {monsters} and picking up their {loot}. You can sell many of the things they carry.
npc.seymour.stdmod_54: Once a monster is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other items which you can sell to {merchants}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_55: You can even sell some corpses! For example, you can sell fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also buys other dead creatures, just ask him for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_56: You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Buy one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_57: A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large enough to enter.
npc.seymour.stdmod_58: You should not descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {monsters}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_59: A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can buy them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_6: Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_60: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_61: The starter armor, a coat, does not protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_62: The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and buy a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_63: A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either buy it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_64: I fear you have to buy your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.
npc.seymour.stdmod_65: Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either buy them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_66: Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can buy them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong enough, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_67: Many monsters, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also buy food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.
npc.seymour.stdmod_68: Paying for your Tibia account will turn it into a premium account. This means access to more areas and functions of the game as well as other neat features.
npc.seymour.stdmod_69: Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Not that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...
npc.seymour.stdmod_7: Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_70: Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can buy them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.
npc.seymour.stdmod_71: Some monsters poison you. To heal poison, use an antidote potion on yourself. Buy them at {Lily}'s store.
npc.seymour.stdmod_72: Rookgaard is the name of this {village} as well as of the whole {island}. It belongs to the kingdom of {Thais}, in our world which is called {Tibia}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_73: The island is separated into a {premium} side and a non-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other players.
npc.seymour.stdmod_74: The city of Thais is reigned by King Tibianus. Of course, there are many other cities but you will learn about them later.
npc.seymour.stdmod_75: The most important places in this village are the {temple}, the different {shops}, the {academy} and the {bridges}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_76: There is a bridge to the north and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.
npc.seymour.stdmod_77: You can leave for mainland once you are level 8. To do so talk to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_78: You have to fight {monsters} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {health}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_79: The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right now though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_8: Only nonsense on your mind, eh?
npc.seymour.stdmod_80: Once you gained enough experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {health} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.
npc.seymour.stdmod_81: The farms are west of here. You can buy and sell {food} there which you need to regain {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_82: To attack a rat, simply click on it in your battle list. Make sure that you have proper {equipment}, though! Also, I give you 2 gold coins for each {dead rat}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_83: I personally don't have anything to trade, but you can ask {merchants} for a trade. That will open a window where you can see their offers and the things they buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_84: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_85: Shall I try and take a guess at your destiny?
npc.seymour.stdmod_86: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a sorcerer in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_87: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a druid in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_88: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a paladin in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_89: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a knight in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_9: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_90: Obi sells and buys {weapons}. You can find his shop south of the academy.
npc.seymour.stdmod_91: Norma has recently opened a bar here meaning she sells drinks and snacks. Nothing of importance to you, young student.
npc.seymour.stdmod_92: Oh, let's not talk about Loui.
npc.seymour.stdmod_93: A fine and helpful man. Without him, many new adventurers would be quite clueless.
npc.seymour.stdmod_94: This is Tom the tanner's mother. Other than that, I don't think she is of importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_95: Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village. He sells useful stuff such as {ropes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_96: A traveller from the {main} continent. I wonder what brought her here. No one comes here of his own free will.
npc.seymour.stdmod_97: Billy is {Willie}'s cousin, but he has his farm on the {premium} side of the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_98: Willie is a fine farmer, although he is short-tempered. He sells and buys {food}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_99: A humble monk living in the {temple} south of here. He can heal you if you are wounded or poisoned.
npc.seymour.voice_1: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
npc.seymour.voice_2: Get some training in the academy!
npc.seymour.voice_3: Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
npc.seymour.voice_4: Gain some knowledge in the academy!

npc.siflind.multi_3: Then find someone in Svargrond that brings you to Tyrsung. There, release the termites on the bottom of a mast in the hull of the hunters' ship. If you are done, report to me about your mission.
npc.siflind.say_1: I heard you have already helped our cause. Are you interested in another mission, even when it requires you to travel to a distant land?
npc.siflind.say_10: The next things needed are 2 fish fins. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_11: Do you have the 2 fish fins I requested?
npc.siflind.say_12: The last thing needed is a green dragon scale. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_13: Do you have the green dragon scale I requested?
npc.siflind.say_14: I have now no mission for you.
npc.siflind.say_15: Do you want to buy a jug for 1000 gold?

npc.siflind.say_18: So let's proceed. Take this vial of paint. Travel to Tyrsung again and ruin as many pelts of baby seals as possible before the paint runs dry or freezes. Then return here to report about your mission.
npc.siflind.say_2: Well done. The termites caused just the distraction that we needed. Are you ready for the next step of my plan?
npc.siflind.say_27: Thank you very much. This will help us to defend Svargrond. But I heard young Nilsor is in dire need of help. Please contact him immediately.

npc.siflind.say_3: You saved the lives of many innocent animals. Thank you very much. If you are looking for another mission, just ask me.

npc.simon_the_beggar.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|. I am a poor man. Please help me.
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_1: That's great! I have stolen something from Dermot.
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_10: Even if it worked on girls, I'd rather not be responsible for you ruining your pretty face. I have an idea though. If you help me brew one of these potions, I will sell something nice to you. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_11: I still have a pretty gypsy dress and a pearl necklace somewhere, which you could wear instead of this ragged skirt. For the small fee of 20000 gold pieces, it'd be yours. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_12: You only have to bring me 100 pieces of ape fur, so I can brew the potion. Do we have a deal?
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_13: I can mix a secret potion which will increase your facial hair growth enormously. I call it 'Instabeard'. However, it requires certain ingredients. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_14: For the small fee of 20000 gold pieces I will help you mix this potion. Just bring me 100 pieces of ape fur, which are necessary to create this potion. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_2: You can buy it for 200 gold. Do you want to buy it?
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_3: Well, it's the least you can do for those who live in dire poverty.
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_4: A single cookie is a bit less than I'd expected, but better than ... WHA ... WHAT??
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_5: MY BEARD! MY PRECIOUS BEARD! IT WILL TAKE AGES TO CLEAR IT OF THIS CONFETTI!
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_6: When I was wandering around in Tibia, I lost my favourite staff somewhere in the northern ruins in Edron. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_7: Uh, don't ask me what I was doing there... sort of a pilgrimage. Well anyway, if you could bring that staff back to me, I promise I'll give you my current one. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_9: I can mix a secret potion which increases facial hair growth enormously. I call it 'Instabeard'. However, I fear it works only for men. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_1: Haha, that beard is - well, not fake, but there's a trick behind it. I noticed people tend to be more generous towards a poor gramps. Want to know my trick?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_10: Ahh! Very good. I will start mixing the potion immediately. Come back later. Bye bye.

npc.simon_the_beggar.say_12: You do not have all the required items.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_13: It seems you already have this addon, don't you try to mock me son!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_14: No, no. Our deal is finished, no complaining now, I don't have time all day. And no, you can't have my staff.

npc.simon_the_beggar.say_6: Aha! I can see it! Now that you've waited patiently without shaving, your beard is perfect! All thanks to my, err, potion. Yes. Goodbye!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_7: Hmm, it seems you need to wait a bit longer for the potion to take full effect. Please be patient.
